articleTitle: Deep learning based on word vector for improving bug triage performance
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: Bug triage is the process of quickly assigning bug reports to the most suitable developer so that the defect can be fixed quickly. Usually, the manual triage method not only consumes a lot of time for developers, but also has low ac-curacy. Therefore, how to automatically and efficiently allocate defects has become a hot research problem in the field of software maintenance. At present, the automatic bug triage method has become the mainstream technology, but there are also problems such as feature extraction and insufficient text representation ability. In view of the above problems, the task of automatic bug triage is regarded as a text classification problem. The method for automatic bug triage of multi-scale convolutional neural networks based on word vectors MCNN- BT can more effectively capture the important text features of bug reports, thereby providing more accurate defect repairer recommendation services. Empirical research is carried out in five software projects, Platform, Pde, Jdt, Cdt, Birt. The experimental results show that the prediction accuracy of MCNN-BT method is higher than that of the Naive Bayes method and the Latent Dirichlet Allocation(LDA) method.

articleTitle: Research on network security situational awareness technology for building multi-element, integrated and highly elastic power grid
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: Based on the network security problems involved in the construction of multi-element integrated high elastic power grid, this paper analyzes the network security situation in the operation of high elastic power grid, and uses the logical architecture of OODA [1] to design the situation awareness model, based on the fusion processing technology of massive heterogeneous measurement data, K-means algorithm noise reduction technology Data visualization modeling technology is the key technology to solve the problems of asset perception, vulnerability perception and security risk perception. Gbdt technology is used to solve the problem of network security risk decision-making and disposal. Finally, the technical modules are integrated to form an intelligent network security protection decision-making and disposal system, which realizes the extension of network security situational awareness and its decision-making and disposal [2].

articleTitle: Image recognition based on improved LSTM deep neural network
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: As the application of electronic equipment in people's production and life is becoming more and more common, digital images have become an indispensable means of information, and massive amounts of image data are being generated every moment. Image recognition is a very important research field in the field of computer vision, and the accurate recognition of objects in images is becoming more and more valuable. The purpose of this paper is to study deep neural network image recognition based on an improved LSTM. The five methods and steps of image recognition, the classification of convolutional neural networks on event images, the method based on LSTM subdivision and the existing event image classification methods are introduced. The experimental part introduces the parameter settings, and gives each visual the experimental results and analysis under the characteristics. Through the comparison of classification accuracy, after LSTM network processing, the event with the highest accuracy rate is 98%, which proves the superiority of the network structure constructed in this paper in the problem of event image recognition, and the classification performance has been improved to a certain extent.

articleTitle: Application analysis of electrical engineering automation control under PLC technology
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: With the rapid development of computer control technology and automation control technology, traditional control methods can no longer meet the needs of the market, and analog control technology will also be replaced. PLC technology is widely used in metallurgy, chemical industry, petroleum, steel and other industries. It enhances the stability, reliability and safety of the control system. At the same time, it is also very important to promote energy conservation and environmental protection, improve the environment, and promote scientific and technological progress. The main purpose of this paper is to use PLC technology to analyze the automation application of electrical engineering, analyze the current problems, and analyze the system control application according to the characteristics of PLC technology. Experiments show that the leveling error is less than 0.5 degrees, and the longest leveling time will not exceed three minutes.

articleTitle: 3D Visual effect design of green landscape in indoor environment
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: Interior landscape design has become an indispensable part of people's daily life space. Many contemporary designers advocate a “people-oriented” design concept to create a more pleasant indoor space environment to meet the needs of people's natural attributes. Therefore, the interior landscape art design has an important practical function. The main purpose of this paper is to study the design of 3D visual effects of green landscape in the indoor environment. It mainly analyzes some problems existing in the current society, some principles that green landscape needs to follow in interior design, and reference factors, and uses the k-Ɛ algorithm. Calculate the indoor natural ventilation of green landscape design and conduct corresponding experiments. Experiments show that under the northeast wind field of 2.39m/s, the maximum wind speed is 3.74m/s and the maximum coefficient value is 1.95, which meets the environmental comfort requirements of typical winter wind.

articleTitle: Evaluation of export-oriented agricultural industrialization development model system based on DEA principle
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: The export of agricultural products is an important way to increase farmers' income, increase the employment rate of agricultural employees, and enhance the international competitiveness of agricultural products. Therefore, the development of export-oriented agriculture is the main task of the current government to earn foreign exchange and realize the development of agricultural industrialization. This paper takes the development of export-oriented agricultural industrialization in a province as the research object, selects evaluation indicators according to the development of the province, and builds an evaluation system for the development of export-oriented agricultural industrialization based on the DEA principle. The principal component analysis method is used to analyze the cities in the province. The index evaluation system scores on the three principal components, and the gap between the industrialization development level and the average level is analyzed according to the comprehensive score of each city, so as to put forward suggestions for promoting industrialization development.

articleTitle: Construction of immersive stage space based on information network mode
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: The popularization of digital technology since the 1990s has changed the way people create and perceive art, but also affected the situation of the human body in real life. In this context, the field of contemporary art has become a test field to explore the relationship between technology and body. Under tracking the website information of psychogeography and the "drift" theory of psychogeographic situational, a psychological map is constructed from a browsing order and psychological perspective in immersive drama space. Through the deep immersion in the situation, the psychological map of the psychological activity of the development of the plot is constructed to be suitable for the spatial layout. The characteristics of this paper lies in the psychological reaction of the population of the development of the plot, how to promote the direction of the plot, and based on the theory of "drift" theory, so as to reflect the academic significance of psychogeography.

articleTitle: Effects of Robot Shape Features on Perceived Trust and Acceptance
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: Advances in technology are making robots increasingly available in college classrooms. In this paper, we study the effects of robots with different physical features on students' perceived trust and acceptance. Use 2 (machineness) x2 (gender typicality) between groups experiment design method for research, Participants were randomly divided into four groups. Each group presented an image of a robot's face, representing four mechanical and gender-typical combinations (i.e., humanoid male, humanoid female, robo-male, robo-female), After observing the facial images of the robot, participants were asked to imagine the situation in which the robot would serve as an English assistant teacher in the future. The results showed that participants showed higher levels of trust and acceptance of humanoid robots compared to mechanical ones. In addition, it was found that stereotypes of gender and professional roles also existed in robots. Compared with male robots, participants showed higher levels of trust and acceptance of female robots as English assistant teachers. These findings have practical significance for artificial intelligence research, allowing social robots to be better designed to fit into human interactions in a more natural way.

articleTitle: Application of multi-sensor composite detection insulation material of IOT sensing system in fire early warning
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: Traditional sensor fire detection detects one of many fire parameters and uses a simple threshold algorithm to determine the occurrence of fire. However, due to the randomness and uncertainty of fire signals, detecting a single parameter is likely to cause false alarms and false alarms. In addition, conventional materials are easily burned or melted by fire at high temperatures, which can also lead to erroneous assessments of fire warnings. Therefore, in order to achieve reliable fire alarm performance, people urgently need a material with reliable performance under high temperature conditions. The purpose of this article is to study the multi-sensor composite detection insulating material of the IoT sensing system. First, the characteristics and parameters of the fire are analyzed, then the ignition energy of the fire is qualitatively analyzed, the cause of the fire is studied in detail, and the high temperature is designed. Material selection experiment, select the most suitable refractory insulating material to make fire warning device, and integrate the Internet of Things to conduct experiments on fire detection technology. The experiment shows that the comprehensive accuracy of fire detection based on the Internet of Things is 92%, which is consistent with Actual requirements for high temperature resistance and fire warning.

articleTitle: Rural E-commerce platform based on digital information technology
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: E-commerce, as an effective way to solve the problem of sending consumer goods to the countryside and the circulation and sales of agricultural products, has always been the focus of government departments and academia. Under the vigorous promotion of the state, rural e-commerce has shown a vigorous development trend, which is manifested in the rapid expansion of transaction scale. The main purpose of this paper is to research the application of rural e-commerce platform based on digital information technology. This paper mainly analyzes the functions and functions of rural e-commerce, and establishes a theoretical model of rural e-commerce adoption, that is, consumer e-commerce adoption analysis.

articleTitle: Water conservancy and environmental protection monitoring system based on wavelet neural network
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: Compared with air pollution, my country's water pollution problem is more serious, which needs our attention and protection. The purpose of this paper is to study the design of water conservancy and environmental protection monitoring system based on wavelet neural network. Firstly, adaptive learning and momentum factor are introduced into the parameter optimization process of traditional wavelet neural network to achieve the purpose of speeding up network learning; secondly, an improved genetic algorithm is introduced, and the algorithm is used to determine the initial parameter value of WNN; then comprehensive adaptive Momentum gradient descent method and adaptive genetic algorithm optimize the wavelet neural network, and create the relevant water quality evaluation model to analyze the business requirements and operation requirements of the water pollution online monitoring system. The system architecture, division of system units and interface rules are given, and unit operations are developed. Research statistical data synthesis and storage technology, analyze abnormal pollution sources, record abnormal behaviors, and handle early warnings. The experimental results show that the learning speed of the WNN optimized by AGA is significantly accelerated, the number of convergence steps is 23, and the prediction accuracy is also improved to a certain extent.

articleTitle: Intelligent garment process design platform based on machine vision
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: With the development of computer technology, the garment industry has begun to enter an era of marketing communication based on digital images, mainly characterized by visual and interactive electronic information, and using hypertext links. This paper mainly discusses based on machine vision. Firstly, this paper introduces the garment intelligent process design, then expounds the theory and related application of machine vision, designs and develops the garment intelligent process design platform based on the machine vision theory, and tests the performance of the platform. Finally, the test results show that the performance of the clothing intelligent process design platform based on machine vision is good, the running time and delay time are relatively low, the CPU utilization is maintained at about 3%, and the memory is about 4300k. This shows that the platform can meet the needs of users.

articleTitle: A novel method to constructing domain ontology based on three-way concept lattices models
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: Three-way Concept Analysis is a new theory formed by combining three decisions with formal concept analysis. In this paper, the theory of FCA and its concept lattice can help build ontology. With the knowledge of the domain experts, we can identify the objects and attributes in the domain, build the relationship model through the lattice building algorithm, and finally construct the domain ontology. This paper details the process and ideas of constructing the domain ontology for three-way concept lattices. The paper presents new method to constructing domain ontology based on three-way concept lattices models.

articleTitle: Online marketing mode of homestay based on collaborative filtering algorithm
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: With the popularity of the Internet, network marketing has developed rapidly. In order to help B & Bs find more potential users, increase the conversion rate of advertisements, and improve customer income, a series of products are provided on the advertising platforms of various Internet companies, so how to effectively promote products to customers is particularly important. The purpose of this paper is to study the online marketing mode of homestay based on collaborative filtering algorithm. This paper mainly introduces the rise of the network marketing model and the advantages of the network active marketing model. Based on the traditional collaborative filtering calculation, the algorithm is improved, and the recommendation system is improved, so that the network marketing of the homestay will be richer and faster. Experiments show that there are 40.74 million new netizens in a single year, and the penetration rate of the Internet is increasing day by day. Therefore, we must pay attention to the importance of homestays in online marketing.

articleTitle: Application of remote digital video monitoring and image recognition technology in power system
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: With the rapid development of digital image technology, image recognition technology has been applied to all areas of society, and people's lives have been greatly affected. After the establishment and implementation of the new power system, the power sector has become increasingly demanding in terms of the quality, reliability, and safety of power supply from the power grid. In view of this, this article studies the application of remote digital video surveillance and image recognition technology in power systems. This article first introduces the current research status and results of Chinese researchers on power systems, then analyzes the key technologies and methods of digital image processing, and finally conducts experiments with transformer fans and transformer thermometers as the research objects. The test results show that this paper proposes. The accuracy of remote digital video surveillance and image recognition technology in the power system can reach more than 95%, and it can be well adapted to different environments.

articleTitle: Roaming and transfer of architectural interior design based on neural network
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: The research of neural network is closely related to the research of human vision. Relying on the latest research on the human visual system, further improving the performance of neural networks and finding the next breakthrough in convolutional neural network research is a hot topic in academia. Techniques such as mathematics, statistics and engineering can be used to create visual systems that can understand the human brain environment and cognitive abilities. The visual system is of great significance to the roaming and transmission of architectural interior design. This paper explores the application of neural network in the roaming and delivery system of architectural interior design. Firstly, the paper summarizes the research status of roaming transmission system for architectural interior design, and proposes the optimization of neural network technology based on neural convolutional network in image feature point detection, location and description. This relationship, combined with the hardware features that control the walkthrough scene, provides the effect of smooth movement of intermediate images within and between viewpoint spaces. The paper hopes to contribute to the optimization research of interior design roaming system based on the concept of incorporating neural network.

articleTitle: Single-index prediction based on artificial intelligence big data platform
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: In recent years, with the development of artificial intelligence and the advancement of big data technology, the collection and analysis of data statistics has become faster and more convenient, and the efficiency of data processing has been significantly improved. Based on this, it is possible to predict future trends by collecting data. In this paper, taking power load forecasting as an example, by establishing a single-index prediction model, the artificial neural network method is used to analyze the influence of weather conditions on the size of the power load, and the degree of influence is reflected in the form of weights. The greater the impact, and the error between the predicted value and the actual value is compared, the results show that the actual value of the maximum load and the minimum load are close to the predicted value, and the predicted error is not much different from the actual value, indicating that the artificial neural network method can be used for power load predict.

articleTitle: Construction of cross-border E-commerce product information traceability model based on blockchain technology
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: At present, with the emergence of blockchain and the rapid development of the IOT technology, the application of the combination of the two technologies in the field of logistics has become the current trend. This paper analyzes the characteristics of blockchain technology and IOT technology, as well as the advantages of the combination of the two, and on this basis, puts forward the cross-border logistics product information processing framework. In particular, the current cross-border e-commerce products can not be traced. Taking related cases as examples, the cross-border e-commerce product information traceability model is constructed and a case study is conducted on the model.

articleTitle: Image design of virtual host based on 3D modeling technology
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: With the improvement of modern science and technology, a variety of technologies appear in people's sight, and the popularity of the computer field has become higher and higher. With the progress of the times, people are no longer satisfied with real life and begin to march into the virtual world. Among them, in the field of computer, human 3D modeling is often used to represent a virtual character. The reality enhancement brought by three-dimensional human model has been favored, which leads to an upsurge of research on avatar modeling technology. Therefore, based on three-dimensional modeling technology, this paper designs and studies the image of virtual host. Firstly, this paper describes the background, significance and research status of three-dimensional modeling technology, expounds the relevant technical theoretical knowledge, designs the framework according to the theoretical knowledge, and carries out the experimental operation. According to the experimental data, it can be found that when the value of K is within a certain range, with the change of the value, the running time will decrease according to the linear change, and the error will increase from decrease to increase, reaching the best when k is 23. The model constructed by using the parameters at the best time can meet the experimental expectations

articleTitle: Analysis of the influence of rural land circulation on agricultural economy based on differential evolution algorithm
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: Farmers' land transfer means that farmers transfer their land to others in a fair and legal way in their own name. However, the real ownership of the land also belongs to the farmers, and only the contractor has the temporary land use right. At present, China's agricultural industry is mainly developing in the direction of improvement and processing, and land transfer has become a common system for agricultural management at this stage, with good prospects for development. This paper aims to study the impact analysis of rural land transfer on agricultural economy based on differential evolution algorithm. In this paper, a multi-objective differential evolution algorithm based on multi-swarm strategy is proposed. In order to better solve the impact model of land circulation, the differential evolution algorithm is improved, and a mutation process based on two strategies is proposed, and an external archive set is introduced to store the optimal solution, and the cyclic crowding degree method is used to control the scale of the external archive set. , using a selection process based on a hybrid selection strategy. Finally, an example analysis is carried out, and a multi-objective differential evolution algorithm based on multi-swarm strategy is used to solve the multi-objective environmental protection economic dispatch model. Experiments have shown that after land transfer, 69.85 % of farmers are used for food production, and the main reasons for land transfer are non-agricultural household income and non-labor ratio, both of which account for about 30%.

articleTitle: Design of smart campus construction scheme supported by 5G technology
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: With high rate, high capacity and low latency, 5G network integrates various existing technologies and some innovative technologies to achieve integrated access, becoming a key new infrastructure to support the digital, networked and intelligent transformation of the economy and society, and promoting the transformational leap and innovative development of education and teaching. Based on the foundation of the previous research, the overall solution of smart campus network construction with 5G technology support is proposed: with 5G + all-optical network as the dual engine, multi-access edge computeas the link, SDN/NFV technology as the core, smart campus information security system as the guarantee, and promotion of eMBB scenarios. An efficient and scientific smart campus ecosystem is created to provide personalized and customized services for teachers and students to fully enjoy the convenience brought by 5G technology to campus life.

articleTitle: Network security protection system based on machine learning algorithm
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: With the development of computer technology, network security has gradually become a topic of concern. Illegal intrusions such as network viruses and Trojan horses have caused massive property losses and brought enormous pressure to individuals. Therefore, it is necessary to study the network security protection system. This paper is based on machine learning, which is deeply explored with the purpose of improving the security of the network and protecting people's privacy. This paper mainly uses the experimental method and the comparative method to analyze the time-consuming of computer network data processing and its security protection ability. The experimental data show that the security performance of the system in this paper can reach up to 90.1%, which can guarantee the basic requirements.

articleTitle: Application analysis of neural network in flower logistics demand forecast
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: With the rapid development of China's economy and trade, the flower logistics industry is also developing rapidly. Because the neural network contains a large number of information transmission components similar to the neurons of the human brain, it can be simulated by a computer and be widely used in artificial intelligence. The gray system can effectively solve the related problems of the system with unclear information. Therefore, the combination of gray system and neural network can more accurately predict the demand of flower logistics. The purpose of this article is to analyze the application of neural network in flower logistics demand forecasting. In view of the current development of the flower industry in our country, based on the neural network model and gray theory, starting with the demand for flower logistics, the demand for flower logistics in our country is forecasted. The results show that the average error of the BP neural network model prediction is 7.53%, while the average error of the multi-dimensional gray prediction model is 6.91%. The average error of the gray neural network algorithm proposed in this paper is only 1.17%. Its accuracy is much higher than the other two algorithms. Compared with the other two single estimation algorithms, the grey neural network algorithm has better algorithm robustness and better estimation performance.

articleTitle: Power system fault monitoring based on Internet of Things technology
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: Most of the distribution network in my country is a neutral point resonance grounding system. In various types of faults in the overhead lines of the distribution network, online fault detection and location are the basis for the realization of the power grid system detection function. The online fault location first needs to obtain accurate distribution network operation information, many methods and technologies in the Internet of Things (IoT), have a high reference value for accurately and quickly collecting state information during power system operation. This article mainly introduces the research of power system fault monitoring data analysis based on IoT technology. This paper uses the IoT to perform real-time fault detection on power system faults, and establishes a potential fault location model. The model uses GPRS technology to analyze and evaluate the power system fault status, and use historical data to revise the model to improve the accuracy of power fault status evaluation. The experimental results in this paper show that the fault location model reduces the occurrence of accidents by 26%, and reduces the rate of false alarms and false alarms.

articleTitle: Design of smart refrigerator control system based on Internet of Things
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: The future development of refrigerator should be more humanized and intelligent. A smart refrigerator control system with disinfection function based on Internet of things is proposed. This scheme mainly combines the relevant technologies of the Internet of things to process and display the information collected by sensors, controllers and other devices on the terminal. Users can view various states of the refrigerator, realize the intelligent control of the refrigerator, and bring a new experience to users. The smart refrigerator control system adopts the Raspberry Pi 4 Model B hardware operating platform, embedded in the Home Assistant operating system, uses radio frequency identification technology (RFID) to read the food information of the system, and the wired network access to achieve network security. Small camera is used to collect the images in the refrigerator to realize real-time monitoring and watch the dynamic situation inside the refrigerator. The disinfection module uses negative oxygen ions to disinfect the food sent in. The whole system adopts the combination of software and hardware to develop the intelligent refrigerator of the Internet of things. The test results show that all the functions of the system have reached the expected goals and requirements.

articleTitle: Landscape garden design system based on artificial intelligence
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: Landscape architecture design companies produce a large number of design drawings every day, and the review, recording, and archiving of design drawings is complicated. In addition to spending time on the design of landscape garden drawings, designers also spend a lot of time dealing with the review and storage of drawings. In order to quickly solve these problems, this paper establishes a landscape garden design system based on artificial intelligence. Designers can use the system's garden material library to intelligently design design drawings, and after the drawing samples are designed, they can independently complete the review and preservation of drawings. The process reduces the workload of designers, and can quickly complete design tasks and improve work efficiency. When logging in to the system, artificial intelligence chip technology can be used to identify the fingerprints or facial features of the logged-in user to achieve secure system login. Then, combined with the neural network of machine learning, the performance of the landscape garden design system is optimized with the support of artificial intelligence technology, and compared with the performance value before optimization. The results prove that the performance of the system is significantly improved under the combined effect of artificial intelligence technology and neural network technology.

articleTitle: Tourism culture communication information recommender on account of association rules (AR) mining algorithm
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: In the context of the rapid development of supercomputing, the application of tourism culture communication information recommender algorithm is making continuous progress. The mining algorithm on account of AR must be constantly improved to make the tourism system more convenient and flexible. On account of the AR mining algorithm, the advantage lies in the continuous optimization of AR, the dilation of the corpus of AR, the optimization of the logic of AR, the purpose is to make the tourism culture communication information recommender constantly improve, for tourism information recommendation more intelligent and efficient. This paper studies the tourism culture communication information recommender on account of AR mining algorithm, introduces the concept and principle of AR mining algorithm, and expounds the related content of tourism culture communication information system. This paper tested the actual data of the tourism culture communication information recommender on account of the AR mining algorithm. After repeated tests, it finally came to the conclusion that the simulation rates of tourism planning, payment and reservation, information sharing and travel dream recommendation for customers in the tourism system were 88.12%, 92.03%, 95.02% and 99.10% respectively.

articleTitle: English writing retrieval system based on machine learning algorithm
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: When non-native English speakers write in English, they often encounter situations where they do not know how to say a sentence or how to express a meaning. The current machine translation system is difficult to be practically applied because the accuracy rate is too low and the translation results cannot meet the requirements. Because the online dictionary system can only search by keywords, it is not helpful for the search of the whole sentence. This paper designs an English writing retrieval system to help people write smoothly. The system designed in this paper takes the WEB server as the frame, and establishes the system structure of the retrieval processing module, the query matching module and other functional modules that connect the corpus ontology database. The application experiments of the two machine learning algorithms proposed in this paper, neural network and decision tree, in the retrieval system show that the retrieval effect of the neural network algorithm is better than that of the decision tree algorithm.

articleTitle: APT attack determination method based on independent component analysis
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: With the rapid development of computer technology and network communication, people have an increasing demand for information resources, and various types of data emerge one after another. In this context, there are a variety of attack methods. Apt attack is a common phenomenon in the network environment. It does great harm and even affects the whole Internet society. In order to understand the attack determination method of apt, we study the attack determination method of apt based on independent component analysis. Firstly, this paper introduces the application of independent component analysis method, and then expounds the definition, characteristics and process of apt attack. Next, according to the independent component analysis method, this paper designs an experiment to determine the apt attack method, and detects the decision method. Finally, the test results show that the method has very high universality, good completeness, moderate scalability, good usability and reusability

articleTitle: Video salience detection algorithm based on visual psychology in virtual environment
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: With the rapid development of Internet and image acquisition equipment, the number of digital videos and images is increasing explosively. This paper summarizes the virtual environment and human visual physiology, discusses the research status of video saliency detection algorithms, proposes singular value decomposition, and makes experimental research on traffic scene saliency detection. The results show that the reason for missing detection is the serious color distortion caused by the change of light. The reason for the false report is that there are buildings with high color characteristics in the background.

articleTitle: Smart community security management system based on big data mining algorithm
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: With the gradual improvement of the social management mechanism and the market economic system, the social management subject has transitioned from the unit to the community. The purpose of this paper is to study the design and implementation of a local security management system. Based on the comparative analysis of the existing technologies, the design and implementation of the local information security system based on the J2EE platform is determined. In order to reduce the complexity of development and speed up the development process, the MVC process was developed. From system, the dynamic page and The static pages are isolated from each other, and the modularization of the interface provides corresponding expansibility and portability for different interfaces, which facilitates the access of data storage and can greatly improve the retrieval efficiency. And take SQLServer2005 database as the data storage platform of the system. Take M community as the research object. The community security risk factors are extracted, and a community security prediction model is constructed. The system data statistical analysis is realized by constructing a CART regression tree. The M community security risk degree is 4.54, and the application of the system data statistics function is running well.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of big data system on 5G new media platform
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: In order to implement the development of the all media era and the renewal iteration of the 5g era, the new media platform, which gradually occupies a dominant position in entertainment, has developed rapidly. The way of using conventional system for data processing can no longer carry out accurate and rapid transmission, which also makes the combination of 5g and the big data system of the new media platform an inevitable trend. Based on the premise of 5g era, this paper illustrates the design and implementation of big data system with an example of new media platform.

articleTitle: Medical emergency language intelligent corpus on account of ant colony optimization algorithm
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: According to the needs of many emergency language intelligent corpora, professionals in the field have carried out data search, data acquisition, data de-falsification, noise removal and other processing steps, analyzed the characteristics of the corpus, and developed and designed an intelligent corpus system according to the characteristics of the corpus. At present, the database has stored more than 1.1 million words, 26,000 Chinese medical words, and 3000 sentences aligned with the corpus. These saved data are of great reference value to general corpora and of great significance to medical corpora. Corpus arrangement promotes the progress of natural language processing technology, which can solve a variety of medical communication difficulties in medical scenarios and remove obstacles for medical treatment. This paper studies the construction of medical emergency language intelligent corpus based on ant colony optimization algorithm to accelerate the construction process of medical emergency language intelligent corpus. The data test shows that the ant colony optimization algorithm based on the medical emergency language intelligent corpus construction has high performance in emergency language intelligent corpus construction.

articleTitle: Random Forest Algorithm in Information Personalization Recommender System
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: The advantages of random forest in the era of big data are reflected. Random forest has fast processing speed and high accuracy, which ensures the real-time and high performance of the recommendation algorithm. The purpose of this paper is to study the application of random forest algorithm in information personalization recommender system. Summarizes the development history and research status of random forest algorithm, studies the application of random forest in recommender system, analyzes user behavior data, explains the basic concepts of its classification and environmental information and some criteria for evaluating recommender system, and then introduces Two common problems with recommender systems. Comparing the performance of the two algorithms, the experimental results show that although the experimental results of the Bp neural network algorithm are slightly better than the random forest algorithm in terms of accuracy and recall, after comparing the computing time of different experimental samples for many times, the neural Bp network algorithm is slightly better than the random forest algorithm. The time used is much higher than the forest of the random forest algorithm, about 5 times, and does not change significantly due to changes in the amount of data.

articleTitle: Data mining in smart classroom management system
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: The rapid development of society shows that knowledge-based talents are no longer the main force to promote social progress. Instead, there is a demand for innovative talents. This demand makes us realize that we need to carry out new classroom reforms, so smart classroom education has emerged. Smart classrooms use modern Internet technology to make education intelligent, improve teaching quality and learning effect. This paper designs a smart classroom management system based on the B/S model and SSH framework. Using this system for teaching can realize various functions such as teaching interaction, sign-in recognition, and performance evaluation. Through data mining technology and the introduction of K-means algorithm into the system to cluster students' grades, the results show that the more students who are clustered at a certain level, the greater the clustering error.

articleTitle: Design of management information system of municipal engineering project based on GIS
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: With the rapid development of computer and network technology, GIS technology is widely used in various fields and industries such as transportation planning, land resource management and utilization and protection, environment and public safety, etc. Departments of fire protection, electric power, energy development, etc. have been established own work system, especially in the management of municipal engineering projects. This article aims to study the design of GIS-based municipal engineering project management information system. On the basis of analyzing the main functions of GIS, the problems of municipal engineering project management and system performance requirements, the municipal engineering project management information system is designed. Finally The performance of the system was tested. The test results show that the system response time is faster when the load is 20 users, and at most 50 simultaneous load access system users, to a certain extent, it can be seen that the performance of the system is in line with expectations.

articleTitle: Construction of business English corpus under internet information technology
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: With the development of social science and technology and the continuous progress of information technology, China's Internet era has gradually begun. In recent years, it has developed into the Internet era, representing a new social form. In view of the problems existing in traditional business English teaching, we should pay full attention to the integration of the Internet and the economy and society, improve teaching innovation and teaching rate, provide a more convenient and effective network platform channel for the society, and propose solutions to the problems and promotion of business English in the network environment. Multimodal interactive teaching mode. The results show that the investment in the national education and training industry has increased year by year, and the investment in the education and training industry in 2020 will reach a maximum of 41.57 billion yuan.

articleTitle: Application of GA-SVM algorithm in improvement design of engineering cost model
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of large data deviation and poor resistance of calculation results in the current construction project cost modeling, structural optimization and calculation improvement are carried out on the construction project cost modeling. The SVM algorithm reduces the influence of external conditions on the calculation results, and further optimizes the construction project cost modeling calculation. By using the SVM algorithm calculation formula for capital estimation, design estimation, and correction calculation, the data processing capability and precision construction are further improved. The purpose of this paper is to study the application of GA-SVM algorithm in the improvement and design of Engineering Cost Model (ECM). This paper analyzes the principle of the SVM, the advantages of the SVM algorithm and the kernel function of the SVM algorithm, and finally obtains the experimental results, The empirical analysis results show that the cost model designed in this paper can effectively estimate the cost of the project cost, with small error value, high budget value accuracy, strong anti-interference ability, short running time, wide application range and strong practicability. We conducted a questionnaire and found that more than 84% of people felt that the design ECM was applied to the SVM algorithm, and found that the design efficiency became high.

articleTitle: Design of immersive display system based on 3D virtual engine
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: With the healthy and rapid development of the new generation of information technology, the computer field has achieved a great step of development, and at the same time, there have been three technological development trends in this field: one is human-machine interface naturalization, two is data processing and scientific calculation visualization, and three is computer simulation graphics. The above three technologies are based on computer graphics technology, among which real-time 3D graphics technology and software system is the key technology of computer graphics technology. Dynamic and challenging, 3D graphics is a feature of this state-of-the-art technology, which can be used in a wide range of industries, such as clothing design, virtual surgical systems, urban planning, social networking and so on. Real-time 3D graphics technology has become an indispensable part of software technology. Virtual reality is to create a virtual scene, and its key technology is three-dimensional graphics technology, which also uses real-time simulation and multidimensional development tools. With the improvement of hardware level, as well as the development of many graphics algorithms and core technologies, the real-time 3D rendering effect has been closer to the real physical phenomenon. On the basis of the three-dimensional landscape, in view of the graphics rendering has carried on the detailed design, focus on improved lighting and rendering graphics rendering technology processing, in order to achieve the desired effect, first of all the virtual engine overall structure has carried on the detailed design, and USES the rendering light processing technology and image rendering technology to apply colours to a drawing processing, And finally designed a virtual engine system based on three-dimensional landscape roaming, proposed the application of graphics and image rendering technology research, to achieve the expected results, compared with the previous, efficiency has been greatly improved. However, the complexity of algorithms and many specialized core technologies have made it much more difficult to develop a realistic and efficient real-time 3D application. The virtual engine uses full access to the programmable rendering pipeline to process real-time graphics. The engine uses a delayed coloring rendering architecture. This paper will focus on this core rendering architecture in detail and design a 3D virtual engine based immersion display system design.

articleTitle: Image semantic segmentation system based on optimized neural network algorithm
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: With the development of computer vision, neural network algorithms must be optimized. As an important recognition task of computer vision, image semantic segmentation system is to estimate the pixel-level target tags in the image. It must keep pace with the development and optimize the corresponding neural network algorithm. Recently, deep convolutional neural network is the main solution of image semantic segmentation system. This paper mainly studies the image semantic segmentation system based on optimized neural network algorithm, focusing onoptimized neural network algorithm, definition, classification, principle, future development theory, etc. By means of data demonstration, the superiority of the algorithm based on optimized neural network is proved, and the image semantic segmentation system using this algorithm has more application value. Based on the optimized neural network algorithm, the image semantic segmentation system must constantly strengthen the optimization and iteration algorithm, so that the algorithm is more flexible and changeable complex environment. In this paper, the image segmentation effect data obtained by data reached 88%, 78%,and80% in Pixel accurancy, IoU, and MIoU respectively.

articleTitle: Application of grade prediction model based on classification algorithm
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: In the field of education, using data mining technology to analyze the data of students in the campus, so as to make correlation research with students' academic performance has become an important topic in colleges and universities. This paper mainly studies the model and application of grade prediction based on classification algorithm. In this paper, the improved decision tree algorithm is used to build a prediction model of scores, and the weight of scores is determined by analyzing the proportion of different question types in the examination, and the split information entropy in the decision tree is improved. The collected student data is modeled and analyzed, and compared with other algorithms. The experimental results show that the improved decision tree algorithm proposed in this paper has the shortest modeling time and the highest prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Global path planning algorithm of industrial robot based on neural network
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: Path planning is also an indispensable and important part in the development of intelligent robot technology. Path planning generally refers to that the robot finds a safe and unimpeded path of collision with obstacles from the initial working state to the end target state according to a certain standard of safety evaluation in advance in any working environment with the characteristics of collision obstacles. The principle of artificial potential field method is to find the energy on the path point through artificial method, so as to obtain the problem of energy combination explosion by making the path point avoid obstacles or overcome obstacles. Therefore, based on neural network algorithm, this paper also makes a preliminary and in-depth study on some global path planning and optimization problems required by the development of industrial robot system in the future. Firstly, this paper describes the relevant background, significance and technology. This paper expounds the use of such a method that can decompose a global path planning process into multiple local sub path planning problems to help solve the application of industrial robot technology in solving many practical traffic problems. Finally, the test results show that the system meets the actual needs.

articleTitle: Identification of modal parameter of civil engineering structure based on data mining algorithm
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: As an instantaneous signal processing medium, wavelet has good time-frequency characteristics. Structural engineering, disaster prevention and mitigation, structural seismic analysis, health monitoring and diagnosis in civil engineering address the problem of dealing with non-stationary signals. Therefore, it has great mechanical value and practical significance to apply the newly developed effect of particle transformation on non-stationary signal processing to civil engineering. The purpose of this paper is to study the identification of modal parameters of civil engineering structures based on data mining algorithms. Introduce common data processing methods and their latest developments. Then, according to the parameter identification method, according to the time domain and frequency domain classification, through the simulation example and the improved Morlet wavelet model, only the response data measured by the test is taken as the output and the noise threshold is removed. After preprocessing, the correlation function method is used, based on MATLAB platform for programming. The main modal parameters of the structure are determined by traditional Morlet wavelet, improved Morlet wavelet, SSI method and finite element method. In the sixth order, the frequency difference between the modified Morlet wavelet and the finite element is only 0.06 Hz. The effectiveness and practicability of the improved wavelet Morlet method are verified.

articleTitle: Application of computer 3D modeling technology in highway bridge interchange
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: With the rapid development of highway bridge construction in China, the investment and construction of highway bridges in China will increase day by day. However, the design of interchange curved beam bridge, which has been applied in National Expressway and municipal construction, is very complex and has poor regularity because of the large number of special-shaped components. At present, most of the Architectural Design Institute Co., Ltd. still carry out the design drawing of interchange bridge through the method of manual drawing, but the design effect is poor. The development of computer-aided design of interchange curved beam bridge is of great significance to improve the bridge design level and design efficiency in our country. This paper discusses the requirements of computer 3D modeling technology and the principles of Highway Bridge Interchange setting; Combined with the relevant algorithms of highway and bridge, the average distance of driving vehicles at the interchange of highway and bridge and the proportion of vehicles forced out of the ramp near the ramp exit are tested. The results show that the distribution of the first lane change point is 923.48m ~ 1831.41m, the second lane change point is 642.75m ~ 1498.25m, and the third lane change point is 208.54m ~ 756.84m; Therefore, the lane changing position of vehicles is more advanced, which is the most favorable for the safety and driving stability of vehicles. The data show that the simple exit sign of Highway Bridge Interchange is more reasonable for the safe driving of exit ramp.

articleTitle: Optimization of the loading trajectory in stretch forming process with distributed displacement loading
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: Stretch forming based on distributed displacement loading is a new flexible manufacturing technique to form three-dimensional surface parts. In the forming processes, a variety of different deformation paths can be used, because the external stretching load on each side of forming die is applied at a series of discrete points and the loading trajectory at each discrete point can be controlled individually. To obtain a surface with good forming quality, it is necessary to study the loading trajectory during the forming process. In this paper, orthogonal experiments were designed, and the forming process corresponding to the designed loading path was numerically simulated. Through analysis on the results of orthogonal test design, the optimal loading path for the target surface can be determined. Numerical analysis results show that the surface forming quality (such as deformation uniformity, thickness reduction, forming accuracy, etc.) obtained by this deformation path is indeed better than other paths. The experimental results show that the surface shape obtained by this method was in good agreement with the target shapes, and the satisfied forming results were obtained.

articleTitle: Multi-objective optimization of construction progress based on improved Leapfrog algorithm
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: With the steady development of China's construction industry, construction projects continue to tend to be large-scale and complex, and the corresponding multi-objective construction schedule optimization level is also improving day by day. The research on multi-objective optimization of construction schedule has always been the focus and hotspot of construction project management. This paper summarizes the principle of leapfrog algorithm, analyzes the characteristics of the improved leapfrog algorithm, puts forward the multi-objective optimization theory, and tests the original leapfrog algorithm and the improved leapfrog algorithm. The results show that the improved shuffle leapfrog algorithm is better than the original shuffle leapfrog algorithm when all basic parameters are the same.

articleTitle: New media video female image recognition based on TF-IDF algorithm
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: With the development of computer technology, computer intelligence has pervaded our lives. Video detection technology has become a field of computer intelligence, and its development has also made great progress in other fields of computer intelligence. With the popularization of intelligent video systems, how to obtain the information we are interested in from the new media video has become one of the focuses of the development of intelligent video systems. This paper aims to study the recognition of female images in new media videos based on TF-IDF algorithm. Based on the analysis of feature extraction algorithm, image preprocessing technology and calculation method of TF-IDF value of image area, the existing new media video database is selected as the experiment. Data, using the TF-IDF algorithm to extract the features of the video images, and calculate the accuracy of the TF-IDF algorithm in gender recognition. The experimental results show that the TF-IDF algorithm is more dominant than the convolutional neural network algorithm and the SVM algorithm in female identification.

articleTitle: Trajectory planning and trajectory correction method of welding system based on artificial intelligence
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: The welding seam data of robot welding is one of the fundamental parameters to measure whether the welding equipment meets the actual production requirements, and the welding accuracy is the key to judging the welding data. The purpose of this paper is to study the trajectory planning and trajectory correction methods of welding systems based on artificial intelligence. In order to verify the feasibility and reliability of the trajectory planning algorithm for the corrugated plate welding equipment and the workpiece welding trajectory correction method on the container welding production line, the trajectory planning experimental verification and trajectory correction experimental verification are carried out in this chapter. Through experiments and experimental data analysis, it is verified that the trajectory planning algorithm for corrugated plate welding special equipment and the workpiece welding trajectory correction method on the container welding production line meet the actual production requirements, and can effectively solve the problems caused by manual welding and positioning in the current production process. Deviation leads to problems such as unqualified welding quality. When the displacement is 5mm, the detection error in the X-axis direction, the detection error in the Y-axis direction and the combined error are all less than 0.8mm.

articleTitle: Local stiffness correction of bridge finite element model based on machine vision technology
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: Bridges are an important part of the transportation network, which not only facilitates the flow of people, but also shortens the distance between people and ensures economic growth. With the growth of the economy, the traffic volume increases rapidly, the traffic density and load level continue to increase, the bridge load increases, the aging accelerates, and the reliability decreases rapidly. This paper aims to study the local stiffness correction of bridge finite element model based on machine vision technology. This paper analyzes the composition of the machine vision system, the overview of model correction, the finite element model correction technology and the establishment of the finite element model. And the experimental results are obtained. The empirical analysis results show that the response measurement of the machine vision technology is more accurate than the original response measurement. Using the machine vision technology, the machine vision technology has a good effect, but the effect of the original method only depends on the sensitivity of the parameters and the initial value. The combined method provides the most comprehensive correction. The dynamic response error is large, and the combined method cannot effectively improve the dynamic correction effect and reduce the effect of machine vision technology. After using machine vision technology, the performance of traditional bridge finite element model local stiffness correction has been greatly improved, and we conducted a questionnaire and found that more than 90% of people felt that the local stiffness correction method of the design bridge finite element model was applied to machine vision technology, found that the design efficiency has become high.

articleTitle: Energy management system of papermaking process based on data mining
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: With the rapid economic development, the paper industry will still be in a production situation of high growth and development, and the demand for energy will further increase. The purpose of this paper is to study the papermaking process energy management system based on data mining. Firstly, a large amount of historical data is obtained from the energy management system of the enterprise, and data preprocessing is performed on the original data set, which provides support for the analysis of the energy consumption status of the research object, and also provides support for the subsequent data mining, process monitoring and abnormal diagnosis model establishment. More targeted basic data. Then, based on the historical data, the energy usage of a typical papermaking production line was analyzed, and the power distribution and energy flow of key energy-consuming processes were expounded, and the influence of environmental temperature and humidity on production energy consumption was quantitatively analyzed. The correlation coefficients with production power consumption are -0.135 respectively, indicating that there is a certain positive correlation between weather humidity and production power consumption.

articleTitle: Collision detection system of dual manipulator based on differential evolution algorithm
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: At present, the double manipulator is widely used in manufacturing industry because of its high efficiency and performance. The cooperative action scenarios of the two manipulator are more and more. However, the interference collision between the arms needs to be solved, the obstacle avoidance and the path optimization are optimized. Some cooperative tasks also require the relative position and posture of the two end tools of the manipulator, avoiding collision between two manipulator is one of the most important problems to be solved in the production and manufacturing stage of double manipulator. Traditional intelligent trajectory planning method is widely used to predict and optimize the motion trajectory of manipulator. But the differential evolution algorithm has strong convergence and robustness in theory, and also plays a better optimization performance in the collision detection of manipulator. This paper introduces the theory of differential evolution algorithm, adopts computer simulation to compensate friction force and speed feedback. According to the simulation results, a collision detection system of double manipulator is established, and corresponding measures are taken to ensure that the collision of the two manipulator is reduced during the use. This is not only of great theoretical significance to reduce collision between multi manipulator arms, but also has important practical significance in manufacturing industry

articleTitle: The improvement design of the information processing of bridge assembly
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: The structure of the assembled beam bridge is good, which can combine the excellent mechanical properties of the steel bar and concrete perfectly, and it is easy to construct. Therefore, the application in the medium and small span bridges in our country is more extensive than other types of bridges. The relevant data show that about 80% of the existing bridges in China are medium and small span bridges, while the concrete bridges with small and medium span are mainly assembly type bridges. With the extension of service life and the improvement of traffic load level, many prefabricated girder bridges built earlier have not met the needs of modern traffic. This paper mainly studies the improvement design of bridge assembly information processing. This paper studies the connotation and characteristics of the information management of assembly building projects, analyzes the new modeling technology of Bim and the cooperation of Bim in project management. In this paper, the experimental analysis is used to select the bridge model to establish the third span of the bridge for experiment. The experimental results of this model are compared with the theoretical calculation results, and the results of the research on the assembled bearing capacity of the bridge are directly displayed by the chart analysis. The experimental results show that at the same observation point, the experimental value of the medium load is 53, the calculated value is 208, the bias load experimental value is 10, the calculated value is 5, and the calculated value is inaccurate. The analysis shows that the material strength of the bridge slab is insufficient, the connection between the members is weakened and the rigidity is reduced.

articleTitle: Application of sensing technology in intelligent room temperature automatic control system
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: At present, my country uses a lot of science and technology to build smart agriculture in an all-round way. The informatization and intelligent development of facility agriculture is one of the important projects of smart agriculture. At present, the main research direction of the intelligent production of greenhouses is to realize the automatic collection of greenhouse environmental data and real-time monitoring of data, as well as the intelligent control of the plant growth environment in the greenhouse. The purpose of this paper is to study the intelligent automatic control system of room temperature based on sensing technology. The hardware nodes designed in this paper mainly include a sensor module for collecting environmental parameters in the greenhouse, a control module for adjusting the greenhouse environment equipment, a wireless communication module, a serial communication module and a power supply module for hardware energy control. The experimental study shows that the relative error range of the data collected by the light intensity sensor in the laboratory is between 0.24% and 4.84% compared with the light intensity collected by the light intensity device in the actual project, which shows the validity of the data collected by the sensor in this paper.

articleTitle: Gynecological surgery safety monitoring system based on hybrid cuckoo algorithm
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: Gynecological surgery is a pelvic surgery. The trauma of the operation will lead to a series of changes in the postoperative coagulation and fibrinolysis system. If the balance of coagulation and fibrinolysis system is destroyed and there is a free coagulation state, it will lead to the occurrence of venous thrombotic disease. This paper introduces the principle of hybrid cuckoo algorithm, describes the behavior of cuckoo algorithm, discusses the detection of hemoglobin concentration, and analyzes the common detection methods of respiratory function in surgery. Through the analysis of the occurrence time of venous embolism in the case group, the results showed that patients were prone to venous embolism in the perioperative period (1 week before operation to 2 weeks after operation), followed by patients supplemented with radiotherapy and chemotherapy after operation.

articleTitle: Design of foreign language intelligent translation recognition system based on improved GLR algorithm
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: With the rapid development of computer science, artificial intelligence technology has been more and more applied in all aspects of people's production and life, which has greatly changed people's lifestyle and promoted the development of society. The communication in this field at home and abroad is more frequent and in-depth, which puts forward higher requirements for the corresponding translation quality. This paper discusses the design of foreign language intelligent translation recognition system(FLITRS) based on the improved GR algorithm, and explores the current situation of syntax analysis of GLR algorithm. Taking English translation as an example, this paper mainly analyzes and discusses the processing of language translation and its recognition. Through experiments, the recognition accuracy and recognition rate of dynamic memory, statistics, GLR algorithm and improved GLR algorithm are compared. The experimental results show that the score of language translation based on dynamic memory and statistical algorithm is less than 85, while the score of machine translation(MT) based on improved GLR algorithm is more than 92. When compiling, only the MT through the improved GLR algorithm is closest to the HT. The recognition accuracy is more than 94%, even more than the same level as manual translation, which proves the high efficiency and feasibility of the improved GLR algorithm in foreign language intelligent translation recognition.

articleTitle: Research on the application and challenges of deep learning in urban big data fusion
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: This paper will analyze and discuss the integration idea of urban big data integration, put forward the application path and application difficulties of deep learning in urban big data integration, so as to solve the problems existing in the process of urban development, reasonably match public resources, and further improve the processing efficiency of complex information.

articleTitle: Research into the construction of audio database based on intelligent recognition algorithm
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: Language resource database is a language protection project gradually carried out in various regions in China in recent years, which aims to permanently retain the language characteristics of various regions through information technology. Through professional database architecture, the language characteristics of various regions in China are recorded and archived, so as to provide reference data resources for future generations' learning and research, help Chinese people fully understand the language resources and national conditions in various regions of China, scientifically plan the development of language resources, drive the promotion of Putonghua and realize the scientific development of language resources. In order to further extract the language resources needed to build the knowledge map, the author analyzes the structured data in the Internet through Python crawler technology. After that, the crawler software automatically grabs the topic information of network language resources and extracts the corresponding language resources through regular expressions.

articleTitle: Prediction of English Online network performance based on Xgboost algorithm
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: With the popularization of the Internet and the development of artificial intelligence technology, it is profoundly changing the direction of educational innovation, breaking the barriers between online and offline, and making the online education model develop rapidly. With the change of educational methods, how to evaluate the effectiveness of online education has become an urgent problem to be solved. This paper collects students' online learning behavior data through the online English learning platform, and uses visual analysis methods to further explore the influence mechanism of online learning behavior characteristics and academic performance, and analyzes the characteristics of different learning behaviors in different grades. The English online network score prediction based on the XGBoost algorithm in this paper can allow test takers to predict the test score range more conveniently and quickly, saving operation time and improving work efficiency. In this paper, the XGBoost algorithm is used to construct a grade prediction model for the selected learning behavior characteristic data, and then the model parameters are optimized by the grid search algorithm to improve the overall performance of the model, which in turn can improve the accuracy of students' English grade prediction to a certain extent. The final results of the study show that the prediction accuracy remains above 90%, indicating that the accuracy is high and has certain feasibility. The predicted score is slightly higher than the actual score, and the predicted score range should be appropriately reduced to ensure English scores.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of dynamic intelligent wearable computer software platform
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: In the field of computer technology, intelligent wearable devices are a typical application.
