This paper analyzes the current mainstream dynamic intelligent operating system, and designs a simple, reliable, stable and scalable embedded system according to its characteristics. Firstly, the hardware module and software platform architecture are introduced. Secondly, the development environment and implementation ideas are determined after the detailed research and scheme selection of the whole control system. Finally, the overall functional framework diagram and program flow design are completed according to the specific requirements. The performance test results of the platform show that the operation time and delay time of the platform are relatively low, Low resource utilization, stable number of concurrent users and small fluctuation. This shows that the performance of the platform meets the needs of daily use.

articleTitle: IoT-based intelligent logistics supply chain (SC) management
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: The advancement of science and technology and the rapid development of globalization have intensified competition in the global market. Increased competition in the global marketplace has led to significant changes in the regulatory environment and company-centric content management. Competition between enterprises has slowly transformed into competition between SCs. The inadequacies of SC management are also becoming more and more obvious. The research, development and use of Internet technology have brought new development opportunities to traditional SC management. The main purpose of this paper is to study the SC management of intelligent logistics based on the IOT. Starting from the system functions, based on principles and path conversion, according to different needs and internship possibilities, the logistics SC management is improved. Experiments show that, in the first indicator weight of supplier assessment, the logistics weight value is 0.309, which is the highest among the 5 indicators, so the logistics situation will be given priority.

articleTitle: Intelligent recognition model of English translation based on cloud computing GLR algorithm
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: Language communication and understanding involve more and more fields. Human-computer interaction, translation systems, etc. have entered our lives more and more, and are and will change the way of production of our lives. The GLR algorithm can analyze English translation sentences well, and its analysis time complexity is lower than that of parallel algorithms. The main purpose of this paper is to design and study the intelligent recognition model of English translation based on the GLR of cloud computing. The paper mainly lists the main points of the GLR algorithm, the characteristics of the word algorithm, and the classification of words and collocations through calculation, which is convenient for intelligent and so on. Experiments show that the accuracy of English translation is improved by 24% after proofreading, and there is a difference. Therefore, the intelligent recognition model of English translation of this system is relatively very effective.

articleTitle: Construction of intelligent elderly care service platform based on neural network algorithm
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: With the gradual affirmation of family informatization and the networking with the community, caring for community-based care for the elderly will become an inevitable practice for elderly care in the information age. Therefore, it is imperative to develop an intelligent elderly care service platform based on neural network algorithms, and in view of the local sound information management of the elderly, improve the existing local elderly care service model to solve the problem of inappropriate local elderly care services. Let the elderly also enjoy the convenience of information technology services. The purpose of this paper is to study the intelligent elderly care service platform based on neural network algorithm. This paper introduces the neural network model and analyzes the applicability of intelligent decision-making. Through the comparison and selection of neural network, it is applied to the system modeling of home intelligent decision-making and the decision-making algorithm design. Finally, build a platform for the intelligent decision-making system in the entire home environment, and determine the evaluation standards and methods of intelligent decision-making. The experimental research shows that the number of requests per second that can be processed by the main functional interfaces of the platform designed in this paper is mainly between 5000-10000, which can basically meet thousands of community elderly groups.

articleTitle: Key technologies of cross-domain authentication for big data security applications based on blockchain technology
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: As the human economy and society enter the era of big data, and the application of big data analysis is booming, the value of data analysis has doubled. The design and application of big data systems have shown unprecedented complexity. Traditional protection methods have been unable to adapt to the new security requirements of the big data processing environment, so security issues have become increasingly prominent. Research on data verification methods and cross-domain applications is great significance to the secure sharing of big data across regions, industries and companies. In the paper, the big data security application and cross-regional verification technology of blockchain technology are discussed, and the relevant theoretical knowledge is understood on the basis of the research literature, and then the big data security application using blockchain technology is cross-regional. The verification method was conceived, and the design method was tested. The test concluded the privacy protection-oriented service invocation authentication protocol proposed in this paper is compared with the invocation authentication protocol based on the PKI mechanism. When the number of transmissions reaches more than 6 the message the length reduction rate a tends to 0.90.

articleTitle: AI-based positioning approaches in the IoT era overview
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: The applications of Internet of things(IoT) have been growing, such as smart home, smart cars, E-healthcare, smart energy and Industry control. IoT paradigm is to connect everyone and everything anywhere and anytime to share information. Any physical object will be provided IP address to be connected with internet. Every connected thing is able to transfer (send and receive) data through the network. It's necessary to localize the transferred data because any data received from unknown location is meaningless. The positioning system should be in both indoor and outdoor areas. The applications that will be building are needed to be positioned without respect to global positioning system (GPS) system because of lack of signals in indoor area and harsh environment. Wireless sensor networks(WSNs) are the main pillar in positioning to enable IoT because of their functionality and capability in sensing, communication, computation and processing. The interconnected sensors in WSNs cooperate to transfer and collect the required information with purpose of positioning the unknown nodes.Many algorithms have been used to localize the unknown sensor nodes but with unsatisfied accuracy. The combination of WSNs and IoT makes the infrastructure more connected and intelligent. Artificial intelligence(AI) could be used to improve the positioning accuracy. With AI the algorithms can be constructed to learn from available data (anchor nodes) and predict the unknown sensor nodes positions. A huge amount of data that will be transferred through the network for different valuable purposes so the IoT networks provide many technologies (such as: sensors, wireless communications, smart phones, IPv6 and etc.) to transfer, gather, organize and analyze data.

articleTitle: Single chip microcomputer intelligent control system (ICS) based on PLC
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: With the rapid development of social technology, the concept of intelligence has appeared in more and more new media, and intelligent products have increasingly entered people's daily life. The public's demand for modern quality of life is also higher and higher. In order to produce more stable and efficient X-ray, this paper invents and designs a single chip microcomputer intelligent management system using PLC. A single chip microcomputer ICS based on PLC is designed. The new high voltage DC switching power supply and high frequency filament power supply technology are applied to the control circuit with PLC as the control core, so that the X-ray machine realizes the control and output design of tube current (kV) and tube current (MA). Through repeated detection and debugging, the intelligent controller designed by experiment can realize the prediction results and specific technical indicators. Through PLC operation, the controller can realize the continuous adjustment of short tube current from zero to 300 kV, small focusing current from zero to 3 Ma and large focusing current from 0 to 10 mA. So as to achieve complete digital intelligent management.

articleTitle: Layout optimization of distribution automation terminals based on FPAG and power supply reliability analysis
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: The electric power industry is a public basic industry related to the national economy and an important energy industrial system. The reliable and stable operation of the power system is an important guarantee for the sustainable development of the national economy and social stability. As the terminal link of the entire power system, the power distribution system is directly connected to the power load. Once the power distribution system fails, it will inevitably lead to a power outage for the power load, which will have an important impact on the national economy and people's lives. It is an important part of power system research. This paper designs the transformer hardware of the distribution automation terminal equipment through FPAG, and establishes the distribution network loop model to keep the power system stable during the power supply process, and then analyzes the optimization results of the distribution automation terminal layout through three examples of the power system. The reliability of the power supply is improved after the reliability index evaluation results are optimized.

articleTitle: Maya software's polygons modeling technique and research
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: Maya software is a universal 3D software with complete modules and many functions. Polygons modeling method is a general modeling method in Maya software. Firstly, this article expounds the usages of polygons, including the common commands, advantages and disadvantages of polygons and the general methods of character modeling. Secondly, in terms of deep-seated use skills, it is explained together with sculpture modeling. The purpose to let everyone better understand the flexibility and applicability of polygons modeling method. This paper mainly adopts the method of example operation, and introduces the modeling method and technical characteristics of polygons in detail. The use of polygons is changeable. It will be combined with different three-dimensional software. It has strong operability and wide utilization rate. In the face of different cooperation, it needs constant trial and error.

articleTitle: Simulation technology of aircraft electromechanical equipment maintenance based on virtual reality technology
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: In order to ensure the punctual and safe operation of airlines, it is necessary to improve the maintenance technology of aircraft electromechanical equipment. Traditional mechanical and electrical equipment maintenance costs are high, and maintenance efficiency is low. In order to make up for the shortcomings and deficiencies in the maintenance of traditional aircraft electromechanical equipment, and to help airlines improve their maintenance level, the research on the simulation technology of aircraft electromechanical equipment maintenance based on virtual reality technology is very important. The purpose of this article is to research the aircraft electromechanical equipment maintenance simulation technology based on virtual reality technology. This paper proposes a virtual maintenance method for aircraft electromechanical equipment based on virtual maintenance technology, and designs a virtual maintenance system for electromechanical equipment to meet the daily maintenance requirements of maintenance personnel and achieve the purpose of training and retraining. The target positioning experiment results show that the average error of the X-axis is 8.6mm, the average error of the Y-axis is 8.2mm, the average error of the Z-axis is 7mm, and the average target positioning error is about 1 cm. The error is within the acceptable accuracy range, which verifies is feasible and accurate to locate the position and direction of the target in the world space coordinate system through image matching.

articleTitle: Operational risk assessment of stadium network platform using K-means algorithm
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: With the rapid development of the information age, the policy support and response of the industrial integration development, the informatization operation mode of stadiums came into being. In the complex network environment, the complex operation background cannot be ignored. If there are fewer potential risks, the occurrence of a certain risk may affect the normal operation of the platform, or even cause irreparable losses. Therefore, it is extremely important to research, manage and respond to the potential operational risks of the stadium network platform. In this paper, the expert investigation method is used to analyze the risk indicators existing in the network operation platform of the stadium, and the K-means algorithm is used to cluster and study the risk indicators, and four main risk indicator systems are obtained. The indicators are used for risk assessment to determine the risk level of the operation of the stadium network platform.

articleTitle: Effects of social media on IT projects
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: Virtually every industry has benefited greatly from the internet and social media by incorporating them into their daily operations and the information technology industry is no exception. Though the effects of social media on project management have been extensively studied, little study has been done to specifically examine the effects of social media on IT project management. This study was done to find out how social media affects IT project management and to see if social media can be used effectively if it is supervised. An 8-question and 15-item questionnaire was used for this study, and it was circulated via social media to a sample of 381 IT team members from the private and public sectors. Only 82 out of 371 participants disagree that social media platforms are appropriate for project communication; the remaining participants think that social media facilitates collaboration. SPSS was used to analyse the data collected from 381 participants. The findings showed that social media has a favourable effect on IT project management throughout both the development stage and promotion. This study also demonstrates the critical role social media plays in today's IT project management for other notable project successes, supporting communication, data sharing, team building, enhanced member cohesiveness, job assignments, and project promotion. The report urges IT project managers to incorporate social media use in IT projects, but to do it in a way that will yield the best results.

articleTitle: A new mathematical probability based card counting strategy for blackjack using phyton
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: Blackjack, further known as twenty-one and pontoon, is a world-known casino banked game. This study elucidates a new card counting strategy based on mathematical probabilities where an edge could be gained on the house. While the existing strategies predominantly focus on overcoming the casino house edge in the interest of betting higher or lower, our strategy, PyCount, not only achieves this but also calculates whether a player ought to hit or stand. Python Module Random was used to construct the model. We compared PyCount with six of the most successful existing strategies. The results validate that the win plus draw rate is 58.61% for our approach, which is approximately 7% more than the figures of the other strategies.

articleTitle: Intelligent space system under the concept of meta-universe
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: Intelligent space supervision is a focus of social development. If the space system is unsupervised, supervisors cannot completely eliminate the risks of the space system, such as systemic risks of the space system or the failure of space internal elements. If these conditions occur inside the space system, then the user cannot take care of the space system. Adopting modern intelligent system can solve this problem well. At this time, users can conduct intelligent processing on the space system through intelligent performance. In this way, the intelligent performance of space system can be used to exclude exceptions. This paper studies the research of intelligent space system under the concept of “meta-universe”, and explains the related content of intelligent space system. The data show that the intelligent space system under the concept of “meta-universe” greatly improves the intelligence level of space system.

articleTitle: Epidemic population control model on the basis of big data artificial intelligence
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: On the basis of big data artificial intelligence, explore the transmission and evolution law of the epidemic under crowd control. The control model of epidemic population is established through big data artificial intelligence. The results show that the theoretical value obtained by the proposed model agrees well with the actual value, and the change trend of effective regeneration number can reasonably reflect the change of epidemic transmission capacity; Reducing the number of initial susceptible persons and effective exposure rate can decrease the number of confirmed and infected persons, and shorten the time required for the effective regeneration number to be reduced to 1. The number of initial susceptible persons and effective exposure rate are important sensitivity parameters affecting the development of the epidemic. Controlling the number of initial susceptible persons in the same range is of great importance for controlling the epidemic than controlling the effective exposure rate. The prediction results of the epidemic transmission model under the new population control mode are more accurate than those predicted in the previous literature. The law of epidemic spread and evolution has important reference value for government management departments and relevant medical experts to formulate and revise epidemic prevention plans, and lays a basis for countries around the world to prevent similar epidemics.

articleTitle: Emergency logistics system based on block chain technology
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: After the third breakthrough development of blockchain technology and entering the mainstream stage, the comprehensive application of blockchain technology has built a large-scale collaborative society in a global perspective. With COVID-19 sweeping the world, China's emergency logistics system also reflects many problems. Technology applied in this article, through the block chain emergency logistics system, and promote the intelligent route planning, concise, improve infrastructure, to improve the accuracy of the emergency logistics information transmission, the data structured, unification, build more intelligent compact emergency logistics system, to some extent, improve the efficiency of distribution, transportation, save the limited resources [1]. Facing the problems exposed by emergency logistics in today's social situation, the addition of blockchain technology will also effectively alleviate, improve and even break down the information barrier of emergency logistic

articleTitle: Data model construction of information system based on PowerDesigner
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: In the process of informatization construction of large domestic enterprises, more and more enterprises realize that enterprise data center and master data management occupy a very important position in enterprise information system, which is not only the only way for the development of enterprise informatization, but also the basic means to realize the high integration of enterprise application information. Therefore, based on the information system data model construction of PowerDesigner, this paper analyzes and discusses the data specification construction scheme, the information system data model construction architecture, puts forward the information entropy algorithm, and introduces SVM and BP neural network for comparative analysis. The model optimized by genetic algorithm is compared with the model optimized by grid method to predict the effect of the model, and the optimal super parameters and model accuracy based on the two optimization methods are obtained respectively. The test results show that the model constructed in this paper has better prediction effect and less time consumption than the other two prediction models. It only takes 230s. The MAE value of modeling and prediction in this paper is 3.8246 and MSE value is 25.5702, which are lower than that of SVM and BP neural network, which proves the superiority of the modeling method used in this paper.

articleTitle: Performance optimization of frequency conversion integrated machine based on intelligent optimization algorithm
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: The motor and frequency conversion speed regulating system used in the coal mine are still two independent systems, thus increasing the installation space and tedious wiring burden. By integrating the frequency converter and motor into a whole and using the hybrid active filter to reduce the harmonic influence of the motor, the performance of the integrated machine can be optimized and the work demand of mining, digging and transportation can be better met. The optimization model of frequency conversion integrated machine is established. In the process of establishing the optimization mathematical model of frequency conversion integrated machine, the intelligent optimization algorithm, namely the hybrid algorithm of genetic and simulated annealing, is adopted. The optimization algorithm is improved according to the design characteristics and engineering practice of frequency conversion integrated machine. Simulation results show that the optimal design of frequency conversion integrated machine based on intelligent optimization algorithm is effective and reliable.

articleTitle: College counselor information management system based on 3D and internet mobile technology
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: The development speed of colleges and universities in China is increasing day by day, and the construction of informatization is getting deeper and deeper. Many software programs are widely used in colleges and universities. As one of the college informatization projects, the counselor information management system has also been implemented in many colleges and universities. However, there are often very simple counselor management procedures, management has not been fully automated, and more effective support has not been developed for counselor work. At present, this paper studies the information management system of college counselors based on 3D technology and Internet mobile technology. This article explores and utilizes B/S architecture, and develops and designs software platform by combining C# language with SQL Server data system. The main task modules are divided into system controller module, management module and student module. The interface is then optimized using 3D technology. The user interface of the program is strict. Once the user is logged in, the system will execute the user's command and give them the size of the service. In addition, the program has created a counselor evaluation service, where students can also count counselors to measure counselor performance levels. The program provides some data support for the counselor's assessment. After the implementation of the scheme, relevant tests are also carried out on performance and system performance to analyze some hidden dangers, simplify the management process of counselors, and improve the implementation value of the scheme. Experiments have shown that the information processing speed of the information management system in this paper is about 8 times that of traditional manual work, and the counselor's satisfaction with the system is about 90% on average.

articleTitle: Multi-sensory experience based on digital media technology
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: Under the background of the new era, scientific and technological progress has provided a powerful thrust for the development of all walks of life, and the attention of digital media technology has also been rising. The blessing of technology has created a unique era environment for the development of interactive art with multi-sensory experience. The continuous maturity of digital media technology has brought a qualitative leap for the audience to perceive the multi-sensory experience of works. It emphasizes audience participation, arouses audience's subjective initiative, immerses people in the current environment, and realizes new interactive forms through the combination of visual, hearing, touch, smell and other multisensory means. This paper mainly studies the development status and characteristics of digital media technology and multisensory experience, understands the application examples of digital media technology in the development of multi-sensory experience and its significance to the development of multi-sensory experience, and clarifies the development strategy of multi-sensory experience scene design of digital media technology.

articleTitle: Research on target detection, tracking and image fusion algorithm for intelligent monitoring
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: Intelligent monitoring technology is the result of the in-depth development of data technology and visualization technology, which can realize the automatic collection, detection, tracking and early warning of image content, even if there is no artificial situation, it can play the security management function of monitoring. According to the application function of intelligent monitoring in actual places, this paper analyzes the technical principles from the three perspectives of target detection, target tracking and image fusion computing, to ensure that the intelligent monitoring system can still operate stably in different environments and backgrounds.

articleTitle: A machine-learning-based approach to online transaction analysis for personalized customer services
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: With the amount of online transactions surging, online marketplaces are generating millions of transaction data and customer profiles. Providing personalized customer service is becoming a rewarding yet challenging task for online sellers and stores as online customers grow both in number and in diversity [1]. In this paper, we propose a machine learning based pipeline to analyze and visualize online customer transaction data. We perform data cleaning and feature extraction on a collection of online transaction data. We then implemented dimension reduction and clustering algorithms on the feature data to group customers into segments. Finally, association rules are applied to further analyze transaction data in each customer segment.

articleTitle: Computer artificial intelligence control sterilization mode
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: Sterilization is an important part of food processing. Although non-heat sterilization technology is emerging in recent years, heat sterilization technology is still the most commonly used method. This paper constructs a computer artificial intelligence control sterilization mode system. Taking meat products as an example, artificial intelligence nano-capsules were constructed to test the sterilization control effect of the system. In this paper, taking artificial intelligence nanocapsules as an example, using commercially available artificial intelligence wettable powder as a control agent, the high-temperature sterilization effect of nano-microcapsules in meat products is studied. In this paper, the distribution of nano-level and non-nano-level preparations in high-temperature sterilization of meat products is studied, and the distribution characteristics of nano-microcapsules are studied. The bactericidal effects of artificial intelligence nanocapsules, commercial artificial intelligence liquids, thiofuran nanocapsules, and commercial thiofuran suspensions were compared. The results show that AI nano-microcapsules have good sterilization performance on the surface of meat products, thereby improving the wettability of meat products, avoiding the loss of sterilization system caused by liquid medicine rolling, and further improving sterilization efficiency. The EC50 of artificial intelligence nanocapsules, commercial artificial intelligence wettable powders, and commercial thiamine suspensions are 21, 38, and 45μg/ml, respectively, which indicates that artificial intelligence nano-control system microcapsules have the function of improving efficacy and better antibacterial effects.

articleTitle: The photoelectric On-line detection technology of inner surface quality of automobile brake master cylinder
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: In-depth analysis of the purpose and significance of the research on the photoelectric on-line inspection technology for the inner surface quality of the automobile brake master cylinder, researched the development status of the photoelectric on-line inspection technology for the inner surface quality of the automobile brake master cylinder at home and abroad, and proposed the current automobile brake master The main research content and technical indicators of the photoelectric online detection technology for the surface quality of the cylinder indicate the direction for its development.

articleTitle: Analysis and application of computer network system integration technology
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology, computer networks are playing an increasingly important role in the current society. An integrated network management system can make full use of the advantages of various network security tools to eliminate a large number of false positives and false negatives. The purpose of this paper is to study the analysis and application of computer network system integration technology. This paper builds an integrated network management system, and designs and implements the key technologies. This paper builds the basic environment of computer network application mainly for information exchange, publishing and query application, realizes office automation function and provides management means and technical support for administrative management. This paper integrates the integrated network security management system through a variety of network security tools, and builds a security platform that integrates asset management, vulnerability scanning, intrusion detection, risk assessment and other functions, making network management more comprehensive and efficient. Efficient and convenient. Experimental studies have shown that.

articleTitle: Research on the influence of artificial intelligence technology in metalinguistic awareness
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: There are at least two common points in the definition of metalinguistic awareness. One is to focus on the form of language; the other is to focus on the use of language units. At present, the vast majority of studies on metalinguistic awareness only focus on a single item of phonological, lexical, syntactic or pragmatic awareness, while comprehensive researches that generally measure metalinguistic awareness in the context of artificial intelligence technology are relatively rare. This article emphasizes the present situation of artificial intelligence technology and the factual usage tactics of using artificial intelligence technology in the study of metalinguistic awareness, which has a certain systematic reference implication for the progress of foreign language education theory in the context of the continuous evolution in the research of AI technology.

articleTitle: Operation risk assessment method based on power grid knowledge graph
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: The power grid is not only the basic industry of national economic and social development, but also a public utility serving thousands of households. Therefore, the safe and stable operation of the power grid system is an important prerequisite for ensuring healthy economic development and social harmony and stability. The purpose of this paper is to study the operation risk assessment method based on the power grid knowledge graph. Combining the power grid operation risk theory and the power grid knowledge graph theory, a model based on condition-dependent operation risk assessment is constructed to realize the power grid operation risk assessment. Based on AC power flow, a power generation optimal dispatch model based on condition-related operational risk is established, which organically combines operational risk assessment and optimal dispatch. Through the analysis of the system daily dispatch plan, the operation risk assessment model of the power grid with TCSC is constructed, and the random fluctuation of the load and the influence of TCSC on the system operation reliability are comprehensively analyzed. After the installation of TCSC, the system risk index is significantly lower than that before installation. When t=4~5h, the LOLP is 1, which verifies the validity of the model in this paper.

articleTitle: Intelligent recognition English translation system based on machine learning algorithm
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: Since the beginning of the 21st century, in training, life and work, people have become more and more aware of the increasing frequency of communication between different languages. Whether they are idiosyncrasies or forms of communication, there are rigorous issues and increasing demands on the accuracy of translation communication. The main purpose of this paper is to design and research a system for intelligent recognition of English translation based on machine learning algorithms. Rapid advances in computing power, growth and adoption of the Internet, and multilingual knowledge bases in both countries and the United Nations have given us millions of bilingual institutions. More and more researchers are devoted to computational engineering training with success. Experiments show that the NP-sequencing pattern library plays the most important role, and its translation results are improved by 3 percentage points compared to the baseline system Moses. And about 2876 English terms in the whole test corpus can find the same syntactic structure in the pattern library, accounting for about 88.7% of the test corpus.

articleTitle: Dynamic prediction model and visual spatial analysis technology of big data
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: With the continuous development of modern industry, the industrial control process is becoming more and more large-scale and automated, people have more and more requirements for control, and the control objectives are no longer single. According to the actual production process requirements, some controlled variables only need to meet certain The desired interval can be set. In addition, with the increasing complexity of industrial processes, the characteristics of controlled objects are also becoming more and more complex. Not only continuous dynamic characteristics such as physical and chemical reactions, but also discrete characteristics such as discrete events and logical rules, the hybrid characteristics are becoming more and more obvious. The main purpose of this paper is to analyze and study the dynamic prediction and visualization space of big data. This paper mainly adopts the methods of soft constraints and interval control, and studies the hybrid interval predictive control algorithm based on the mixed logic dynamic (MLD) model. Experiments show that the weighted interval predictive control algorithm based on MLD can reduce the maximum overshoot of the controlled variable, and at the same time, the controlled variable in the interval can return to the desired set interval faster after it exceeds the interval.

articleTitle: Power grid planning on power system engineering cost
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: With the rapid development of our country's power industry, the cost management of power system engineering, which is closely related to the power industry, becomes more and more important. As the price of building materials used in power engineering construction projects continues to rise, the cost of power engineering projects(EP) has also risen. How to control the overall project cost within a reasonable range on the basis of ensuring the construction quality of power projects is a key issue that the power industry is paying attention to. power grid planning (PGP) is an excellent power system engineering cost planning method that has emerged for this purpose. In order to analyze the impact of power grid(PG) planning on the current power system engineering cost, this article first combs the status quo of our country's power system engineering cost from multiple aspects, and analyzes the trend of our country's power market reform; secondly, it studies the electricity market in light of the new situation. The impact of system reform on the cost of power system engineering; finally, the advantages of PG planning on the cost of power system engineering under the new situation are studied and analyzed from three aspects. Analysis and experiments show that in the current cost of power system engineering, the use of advanced theories and technical methods for PG planning can make the power system more stable and efficient, and can help grid companies in the construction of PGs in the new market environment. Improve the accuracy of the planning plan and further improve the investment benefits of the project, so as to realize the sustainable development of the enterprise itself and the harmonious progress of the economy and society.

articleTitle: Audit stratified sampling algorithm based on neural network
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: Computerized accounting and electronic business data have been widely used in many units. Sampling auditing of financial and business data of the audited unit is the basis for daily audit work. In the information age, it is very important to extract and mine useful information from massive data. The main purpose of this paper is to study the hierarchical algorithm of audit sampling based on neural network. This paper mainly describes the audit sampling system researched and developed in detail, and promotes the audit stratified sampling analysis technology to a new field through data mining technology. Experiments show that the K-means algorithm of hierarchical division and center division has only a slight difference in data processing results, and most of the variance results are different from 7-20, but the difference between the original K-means algorithm is large, and the advantages are more obvious.

articleTitle: Development of image recognition based on artificial intelligence
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: With the development of computer science, electronics and artificial intelligence technology, image detection technology is becoming more and more mature, and the application of object recognition and detection through image detection technology is becoming more and more extensive. This paper mainly studies the development of image recognition based on artificial intelligence technology. This paper first analyzes the design method of classical convolutional network, hoping to achieve the accuracy level of similar methods in small-scale image recognition with more simplified network parameters and model scale, or even surpass the same methods. In this paper, a multi-structured convolutional neural network is designed for image recognition. The experimental results show that the DSCNN model designed in this paper has higher image recognition accuracy.

articleTitle: On-line monitoring system of grounding wire condition based on data acquisition technology
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: In the power system, the transmission lines are scattered and difficult to protect and repair. The traditional safety measures for maintenance of transmission lines are very monotonous. Most of the task process is directly involved in manual work, and there is no testing facility for hanging ground wires, which is inefficient and unsafe. The main purpose of this paper is to design and improve the monitoring of the state of the ground wire based on the data acquisition technology. A simulation model considering the grounding wire is built, and the influence of different frequency signal injection, multi-branch line, transformer no-load input, the same pole in parallel, the earth-coupled grounding equivalent resistance and other factors are analyzed by simulation. Experiments show that when the frequency of the detection signal is 120 Hz, if the length of the detected line is longer and the grounding resistance is greater, the measured value of the response current when the grounding wire is in the grounding state and the measured value of the response current when there is no grounding wire is the same the smaller the difference.

articleTitle: Design of logistics carrier conitoring system based on data mining technology
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: China's logistics carrier monitoring system is still in the early stage of development, and the use of big data is not mature, resulting in insufficient information in the logistics links. In this paper, data mining technology is used in dynamic collection of vehicle inbound and outbound information, vehicle monitoring and road monitoring. Closely around the characteristics of high efficiency and visualization, the author designs a whole process monitoring, and can show all kinds of data in the form of visual logistics carrier monitoring system.

articleTitle: Embedded software simulation monitoring system based on Internet of things technology
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: With the progress of society, science and technology, intelligent network system is gradually introduced into all fields of people's life. This paper deeply analyzes the practical application of Internet of things technology in embedded software simulation monitoring system, and finds out the problems of Internet of things technology in embedded software simulation monitoring system. Finally, it is concluded that although there are still some popularization problems, the Internet of things technology will be widely used in the embedded software simulation monitoring system, and has a clear future development trend.

articleTitle: An early warning system (EWS) for Dynamic unbalanced monetary data on account of neural network algorithm (NNA)
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: The pace of global economic integration is approaching, and businesss will face more and more drastic bazaar vie. How to keep on top in the drastic bazaar vie is the premise for the existence and progress of every business. If an business can build a set of valid monetary EWS, it can find and adopt efficacious steps to avert greater damage when the monetary situation of the business just appears conjuncture, it can make the business remain undefeated in the drastic bazaar vie. This article introduces the dynamic imbalance monetary data on account of NNA warning system design related content, point out the concept of NNA, the significance, this paper introduces the dynamic imbalance theory and knowledge about the design of warning system for monetary data, illustrates the dynamic unbalance the feature of the monetary EWS design data fabric. on account of NNA of dynamic unbalance progress and design of the EWS of monetary data, thanks to the powerful support of NNA, utilizing dynamic imbalance monetary data on account of NNA day-to-day monetary affairs EWS, the dynamic imbalance monetary EWS design to ensure the safety of monetary data, screening monetary risk in a timely manner. Through data verification, this system has a huge advantage in the monetary feature.

articleTitle: Implementation of parallelization of data mining algorithms based on big data and cloud computing
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: Although traditional data mining techniques have done a lot of research to improve the accuracy of the original algorithms, most of these improved algorithms are very complex and difficult to adapt to the increase in PCs. Therefore, how to balance the accuracy and computing speed, and how to properly improve the traditional data mining algorithm in the cloud computing environment, has become an important research topic. This paper studies the parallelization of data mining algorithms for big data and cloud computing, and understands the theoretical knowledge of data mining algorithms on the basis of literature, and then designs the parallel implementation of data mining algorithms for big data and cloud computing. The algorithm was tested, and the test results showed that compared with K-means++, the algorithm in this paper reduced the misclassification rate by 1.3% and the average error by 0.06, because this paper merged the cluster centers that were too close. This makes the clustering more accurate.

articleTitle: Research on the application of artificial intelligence technology in the carbon footprint of power equipment
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: The low-carbon development of the power industry is a broad energy revolution. The essence of the revolution lies in the innovation of technology and methods. In recent years, with the wide application of Internet, big data, artificial intelligence and other technologies, a wave of technological innovation in the industry has been set off. How to use advanced digital technology to combine with production equipment and production processes to improve energy efficiency and production efficiency, save energy and reduce consumption, reducing carbon emissions has become the focus of the power industry. This paper aims to introduce a monitoring mechanism for power equipment from the perspective of the production side, and combine digital technologies such as artificial intelligence and big data to achieve the coverage of power generation equipment, power transmission and transformation equipment, power electronic equipment and other power equipment industries to improve power transmission efficiency, Power production efficiency, thereby reducing greenhouse gas emissions and promoting the low-carbon transformation of the power industry.

articleTitle: BP neural network in food safety early warning model
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: Food safety involves our most basic personal rights. In my country's national economy, the food industry occupies a very important position. The purpose of this paper is to study the application of food safety early warning model. The improvement of BP neural network, food safety risk early warning and dairy product safety risk index setting were analyzed. Taking dairy products as the research object, using Matlab mathematical calculation software as the main tool, through the design and optimization of the network structure, the network training and prediction of the improved momentum BP algorithm and the standard BP algorithm are carried out, and the overall relative prediction error of the output results is compared. (RPEt), single component relative prediction errors (RPEs). The experimental results show that the model has outstanding efficiency in the process of risk determination, which can buy a certain time for risk safety processing, and facilitate the relevant early warning processing departments to quickly eliminate potential safety risks.

articleTitle: Apparel image recognition method based on convolutional neural network
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: The clothing image recognition technology can extract its element features from the clothing plan or physical map, and obtain clothing information, such as clothing color, outline, material, clothing designers can use this information to design new clothing. The clothing image recognition system designed based on convolutional neural network in this paper can identify various types of clothing by integrating image data information through the system. This paper compares the recognition accuracy and time-consuming of the system for different clothing, and finds that the recognition accuracy of sweaters is the lowest and the time-consuming is the longest. The recognition accuracy and number of network layers show that CNN and AlexNet have the highest recognition accuracy.

articleTitle: Generative adversarial networks based on target hash attacks
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: Due to the powerful learning capabilities of deep learning, deep hashing based retrieval models have been widely used in large-scale image retrieval systems. There is, however, little research on the security of deep hashing based retrieval models, which is a practical security issue. In this paper, we propose a target hash supervised adversarial network (TarS-GAN), which can perform targeted hashing attack efficiently and effectively. As part of this effort, we select a target hash code to supervise the generator in order to construct the adversarial sample by minimizing the Hamming distance between the hash code of the adversarial sample and the target hash code. In addition, the generator and discriminator counterbalance each other to promote more realistic adversarial examples. Numerous experiments demonstrate that TarS-GAN is effective in attacking deep hashing based image retrieval.

articleTitle: Research on intelligent grain depot system based on information technology
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: China is a large agricultural country, the annual grain output in recent years have exceeded one trillion Jin, food security storage problems also followed. So it is very important to develop a measure and control system of grain depot. There are many problems in the current measurement and control system of grain depots in our country, such as the backward sensor technology, high cost, low automation, poor expansibility, lack of information integrated management platform, and a large number of cabling. Therefore, this article unifies the current grain depot construction present situation, proposed the grain cloud design mentality.

articleTitle: A review of artificial intelligence of things
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) has introduced a current and up to date global powered with the aid of networking producing diverse heterogeneous records for a very long time in so many fields and applications. In removing entire facts from those records, advance artificial intelligence (AI) technology, particularly deep learning (DL), has shown a success in facilitating records analytics, destiny prediction, and choice making. The combination of AI and the IoT has appreciably promoted the fast improvement of Artificial Intelligence-of-Things (AIoT) structures that examine and reply to outside stimuli extra intelligently without human intervention. However, it's far difficult or infeasible to method huge quantities of records in the cloud because of the unfavorable effect of records volume, velocity, and veracity and deadly transmission latency on communication infrastructures. This article conducts a survey of the internet of things and artificial intelligence orchestrated architecture for flexible artificial intelligence of things (AIoT) systems. It begins by explaining fundamental concept of the internet of things and artificial intelligence with this it explains the overall artificial intelligence of things architecture show and example of AIoT to illustrate how AI can be used in real world and summarize IoT and AI application.

articleTitle: Construction cost optimization technology based on decision tree CHAID algorithm
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: With the rapid growth of the construction engineering industry, the construction industry has made great progress, but in the process of its development, there have been many irrational growth models such as extensive growth and real estate bubbles. In addition, with the continuous advancement of the development of construction projects, the types and modes of construction projects have become more and more complex, and the importance of construction project management has become more and more prominent. This article will discuss the cost of construction projects. Make a relative cost optimization technology research, this paper adopts the decision tree CHAID algorithm to solve the cost management problem of construction projects, and proposes corresponding cost optimization technical solutions, which is conducive to the integration of China's construction industry with the international industry and the promotion of my country's industrial structure transformation. From the perspective of decision tree structure, the earliest decision tree is a multi-forked tree structure, which is it brings some trouble to interpreting the rules of the decision tree, while the decision tree CHAID algorithm generates rules that are easy to understand, easy to implement, fast, able to process data-type and general-type attributes at the same time and calculate massive data good. This paper mainly studies the design of mechanical equipment fault detection robot, proposes a series of data model analysis, and analyzes the main theories and characteristics of the electronic tracing algorithm. 3.98s, the running time of single-machine multi-threading is 3.87s, while the running time of decision tree CHAID is 3.79s, the relative acceleration is slightly higher than that of single-machine single-threaded and single-machine multi-threaded.

articleTitle: Emotional interaction design of an artificial intelligence voice
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: In the era of artificial intelligence, user experience can be improved through the design of human-computer interaction. This paper first introduces the concept, development and future development trend of artificial intelligence speech technology. Secondly, through the emotional design experiment of the human-computer interaction of artificial intelligence voice, the emotional voice interaction experience can be obtained through the user's evaluation and feedback. Finally, the conclusion is drawn that the user needs the artificial intelligence voice emotional interactive experience.

articleTitle: K-means algorithm for cluster analysis in human resource information management system (HRIMS)
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: With the development of the information industry, management informatization is also changing with each passing day, and it is also increasingly popular in enterprise management. As a part of it, the HRIMS undertakes the important responsibility of evaluating and managing the results of people's work behavior. The main purpose of this paper is to use K-means algorithm to conduct research on HRIMS. In addition to analyzing the information resource management system, this paper also studies related algorithms. The experimental results show that the improved k-means algorithm requires only half the number of iterations of the traditional one, which also shows its superiority in time. Although a sorting process is added to remove the largest and smallest values in the algorithm, the time complexity of the final operation is still greatly reduced.

articleTitle: Target detection and semantic segmentation algorithm in complex industrial scene
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: Target detection and segmentation in complex background is a very important topic in the field of computer vision. In recent years, with the progress of science and technology, a variety of electronic products have been produced and applied in various fields, which has a significant impact on people's work and life. At the same time, the use of electronic products also produces a large amount of data. The storage, screening and extraction of interested information of these data have been paid more and more attention. As the most accessible and understandable information medium, image has become one of the main ways of information dissemination. One of the topics is image target detection and segmentation. How to use computer to detect a large number of interesting targets in images with high precision becomes more and more important. Based on the complex industrial scene environment, this paper studies the target detection and semantic segmentation algorithm. Combined with the deep lab semantic segmentation network algorithm, the classification accuracy and position regression accuracy of various parts in different training stages are measured, and the experimental results are analyzed and evaluated. The results show that the category prediction accuracy of the five categories of targets is close to the convergence of the category prediction recall rate, and the average accuracy has reached the excellent effect of 98.80%. In the fifth epoch, the average accuracy has reached the excellent effect of 99.50%; The position accuracy basically converges from the sixth epoch, and the average position accuracy converges to 89.60%. Therefore, the research trend of visual detection in complex industrial scenes will inevitably shift from traditional statistical machine learning technology to target detection and semantic segmentation algorithm technology; It is equally important to improve the real-time effect and detection performance of target detection and semantic segmentation algorithms.

articleTitle: Design and realization of pharmaceutical survey data acquisition and analysis system based on principal component analysis algorithm
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: With the rapid development of electronic communication technology, data acquisition systems have been widely used in all aspects of people's daily lives. Especially in the medical field, there is an urgent need for a pharmaceutical survey data collection and analysis system. In the massive pharmaceutical survey data, the principal component analysis algorithm is used to condense the attribute variables of the original data, which greatly improves the efficiency of data collection and analysis. Based on this, this article will study the pharmacy survey data collection and analysis system based on principal component analysis algorithm. This text first carries on the system function structure design, designs the system development framework from the hardware layer, the interface layer, and the middle layer. This paper designs the functional modules of the system in detail, including account management, file management, and report management. Finally, the system found through testing that the average delay for obtaining diagnostic reports, previous inspections, static files, and querying patient information were all about 40ms. This shows that the system runs at a high speed and can meet practical applications.

articleTitle: Application of particle swarm optimization algorithm in improved association rules data mining method
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: The traditional particle swarm optimization algorithm is generally only suitable for solving the association rule mining of continuous data, and the improved PSO algorithm needs to be used for the association rule mining of discrete data. Firstly, the FP-growth algorithm is used to construct a fuzzy FP-tree to mine frequent itemsets, and then the PSO algorithm is applied to the mined frequent itemsets. Aiming at the shortcomings of the association rule mining algorithm of PSO, an improved association rule data mining algorithm is proposed. This paper proposes application of particle swarm optimization algorithm in improved association rules data mining method. Experiments show that the particle swarm optimization algorithm proposed in this paper is feasible and efficient in improving association rule data mining.

articleTitle: Agent-based intelligent monitoring and security system of distributed database
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: In recent years, with the vigorous development of science and technology, more and more social institutions, such as schools, hospitals, government agencies and enterprise organizations, have successively established their own databases, and used their own databases to help their own operation and management. With the development of network informatization, the establishment of its own video surveillance system has gradually become an auxiliary tool for various enterprises and institutions. This paper researches on the intelligent monitoring and security system of Agent's distributed database, and proposes how to efficiently carry out the intelligent monitoring and security system of the database with the help of the distributed database of Agent. In view of the shortcomings of traditional monitoring security systems, this paper proposes an intelligent monitoring security system based on distributed data theory, which has higher monitoring efficiency and can be better applied to life. Nowadays, with the vigorous development of science and technology, all walks of life have developed the trend of "Agent", and many enterprises and institutions are more and more inclined to use the distributed database of Agent to help themselves improve their understanding of intelligent monitoring and security systems. The final results of the study showed that the accuracy of enterprise one was 54%, the accuracy of enterprise two was 36%, the accuracy of enterprise three was 27%, the accuracy of enterprise four was 63%, and the accuracy of enterprise five was 58%. From the data analysis, it can be seen that the value of enterprise accuracy varies greatly, and the data has a large fluctuation.

articleTitle: GIS algorithm in the construction of virtual simulation experiment platform and teaching system
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: The development of network and multimedia information technology has greatly promoted the teaching efficiency of more and more courses. The purpose of this paper is to apply GIS algorithm to the construction of virtual simulation experiment platform and teaching system. resources to make teaching easier. Under the guidance of constructivism and spatial intelligence theory, based on the design of university physics script, combined with the generation and analysis algorithm of irregular triangular network and the animation demonstration mechanism based on key events, the university physics subsystem is designed and developed. Conduct teaching experiments through experimental research method, select students from two classes in the first grade of a university, and the control group uses ordinary teaching methods; the experimental group uses the GIS teaching system designed by the author for teaching, and the experimental results are statistically analyzed. The results showed that the average score of the experimental class increased from 60.5 to 82.7, the average score of the rear side increased more than that of the control class, and the standard deviation decreased from 3.24 to 3.04. Therefore, the teaching system has a stronger effect on student achievement than the traditional teaching method.

articleTitle: Analysis of influence factors of distribution network engineering cost
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: In order to solve the problems existing in the cost management of distribution network engineering, this paper analyzes the factors influencing the cost of distribution network engineering by using analytic hierarchy process. The analysis results show that the factors influencing the cost of distribution network engineering in the design stage, construction stage and completion stage have a great impact on the cost of distribution network engineering. Then the fishbone diagram analysis method is used to focus on the specific influencing factors of the above three parts for further analysis, so as to find the problems existing in each influencing factor, determine the key points that need to be improved and solved, and then put forward effective targeted control measures to provide guidance and reference for the cost management of distribution network engineering.

articleTitle: Algorithms for detection and tracking of human targets downhole based on deep learning
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: With the development of human society, the development and utilization of resources such as oil and coal has become more and more in-depth. In the mining process, deep excavation and transportation of the stratum are often required. However, the underground environment is complex. In the process of mining and construction, the underground operating conditions are getting worse and worse, and it will also consume a lot of time and human resources. At the same time, deep learning (DL) has become a hot research topic, and it has made great progress and achieved great results in image recognition and other fields. Therefore, in order to ensure the safety and efficiency of production, this article combines DL technology, and explores target detection and tracking algorithms, and explores its application in detecting and tracking pedestrian targets, so as to discover potential safety hazards and issue warnings in time. This article uses experimental analysis and data analysis to better understand the tracking effects of these methods through experimental research, so as to better complete the task of pedestrian target tracking in the underground environment. According to the experimental results, compared with other methods, the feature fusion tracking method proposed in this paper produces smaller errors, higher recognition accuracy, shorter computing time, and produces better results in pedestrian target tracking in underground environments.

articleTitle: Key technologies of cloud computing oriented carbon footprint quantification model
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: With the rapid development of cloud computing (CC) technology, more and more enterprises begin to adopt advanced concepts and methods to improve their core competitiveness. As an important quantitative indicator, carbon footprint can effectively reflect the carbon emissions of a region or country. Therefore, based on CC, this paper studies the key technologies of carbon footprint quantification model. Firstly, this paper expounds the concept and characteristics of carbon footprint, then introduces the basic principles and research ideas of CC, then designs and studies the carbon footprint model, and tests the performance of the model by using the simulation data running environment. Finally, the test results show that the total consumption time of the carbon footprint quantification model based on CC is short, and the carbon emissions can be accurately calculated. This shows that the model can meet the needs of users.

articleTitle: Brand loyalty prediction model based on machine learning classification algorithm
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: Brand loyalty describes a consumer's psychological attribution, and the behavior of this attitude is reflected in the repeated purchase of the brand's products, or the first choice of the brand when many brands are displayed, that is, based on emotional loyalty. Repeat purchase behavior status, and brand loyalty is a measure of consumer loyalty to a brand. This paper aims to study the research on the prediction model of brand loyalty based on machine learning classification algorithm. Starting from the brand relationship theory and social capital theory, this paper explores the brand loyalty prediction model based on machine learning classification algorithm in the context of mobile Internet. In this paper, the machine learning classification algorithm technology finds the characteristics that can describe customer loyalty, and establishes a customer loyalty prediction model. According to the model, the loyalty level of each brand customer can be effectively predicted. Experiments have shown that the accuracy of the loyalty prediction model constructed in this paper has reached about 80%, and under the application of the model, the proportion of people who purchased brand products in the past year has reached more than 95%.

articleTitle: Supply chain entity collaboration system under the condition of intelligent logistics
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: The development of logistics industry is of strategic significance in my country's economic transformation. With the trend of economic globalization and integration becoming more and more obvious, the operational complexity of the logistics supply chain has greatly increased. Under this trend, logistics enterprises began to cooperate, and gradually formed a logistics service supply chain model. The purpose of this paper is to study the collaborative system of supply chain entities based on intelligent logistics. The basic elements of collaboration are listed, and according to the characteristics of LSSC collaboration and the collaboration relationship, reliability detection and centralized decision-making algorithms are proposed, and the operation mode of the collaboration system is analyzed. Experiments show that Cronbach's alpha results range from 0.784 to 0.909, all of which exceed the standard of 0.7 proposed by Numally. Therefore, the scale can be considered to have a good level of reliability.

articleTitle: Explore the smart home design and realization in the era of information technology
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: With the progress and development of modern science and technology today, human society has already entered the information society accordingly. The digitalization and intelligence of information technology have been widely spread, convenient for people's daily life, but also make the use of information, so that people's life quality and efficiency have been greatly improved. In this way, information technology gradually enters people's vision. This article is starting from people's daily life demand for home design, and explores the impact, application and realization of artificial intelligence "A I" (Artificial Intelligence) on home design in this era of information technology.

articleTitle: Application of improved bp algorithm in handwritten english text recognition system
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: With the wide application of artificial intelligence technology in intelligent education, intelligent office and other fields, handwritten optical character recognition (OCR) as an important content of intelligent education research has been widely concerned. Traditional character recognition technology is mainly for high-quality printed images, but there are some problems in English handwriting, such as irregular handwriting, overlapping letters, word smearing, etc., which can not achieve the recognition accuracy of printed images. In particular, the lack of database construction for handwriting images with scrawl and daub increases the difficulty of model training, so handwriting recognition is a very challenging task. In view of the existing problems mentioned above and the limitations of traditional handwriting recognition methods, this paper studies the English handwriting recognition method based on deep learning technology, and realizes the English handwriting image detection and recognition system on this basis. The main tasks of this paper are as follows: 1. The database of English handwriting image is established, including neat, scrawl, neat and smeared and scrawl and smeared. Label information is assigned to each type of data, and SVM classifier is trained to classify new samples using this database. In order to reduce the interference of smear area and background information on the character recognition model, the image is preprocessed with smear block removal, gray scale and tilt correction, and the processing results are used as the input of the subsequent detection and recognition model. 2. A convolutional cyclic neural network based on cross-channel and cross-space attention mechanism is proposed. The convolutional neural network is used to extract local feature information and cross-channel and cross-space attention mechanisms are introduced to reduce the loss of key features. At the same time, bidirectional recurrent neural network is used to capture the context dependence of characters and obtain the word order information of English script. 3. An English handwritten recognition method based on Semantic Reasoning Networks (SRN) and CCSACRNN (SNCN) is proposed.

articleTitle: Development of a full-wave underground MRS receiver system based on LabVIEW
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: For forecasting the mud and water inrush disaster in underground engineering, this paper constructed a full-wave underground magnetic resonance sounding (MRS) receiver system. In this paper, used the receiver coil matching technology and the receiver system timing control technology to complete the lower machine main circuit design; PC control software used "producer - consumer" programming framework developed in LabVIEW platform; Using Tablet PC as a terminal data collection, and data transfer via a remote network; The overall used of water proof enclosure, safety design for underground engineering; Volume and weight of the system is more lightweight and easy to carry out field work. This paper presents key system design methods and stable and reliable test results, provides full-wave underground detection of MRS method and provides instrumentation platform in underground engineering applications.

articleTitle: Engineering data processing system based on RDA algorithm
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
