abstract: With the continuous development of enterprise informatization and the gradual development and application of computer in the field of engineering, computer drawing replaces manual drawing, CAD according to The technical path of "drawing board → integrated product engineering information management → network system integration → CIMS" is carried out in an all-round way in stages and steps. At the same time, the electronic data information in the product life cycle has doubled. In such a huge data information base, how to accurately and quickly find the required information, how to reduce the redundancy of data and how to shorten the product design cycle is an important problem faced by enterprises This paper studies the design of engineering data processing system based on RDA algorithm. Firstly, this paper first describes the relevant background and significance, and expounds the relevant technologies. Build a data processing system based on RDA algorithm technology. Finally, the test results show that the system meets the actual needs.

articleTitle: Ground elevation retrieval from photon-counting LiDAR data based on Quadtree Isolation and Cloth Simulation
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: The Ice, Cloud, and Land Elevation Satellite-2 (ICESat-2), the first global photon-counting LiDAR satellite, can be used to draw global elevation maps and monitor their changes. However, a large amount of noise in the photon data poses a challenge to the surface elevation retrieval from the photon data. The purpose of this study is to propose and verify an effective algorithm framework that can accurately extract signals from the photon data and retrieve the ground elevation. The framework includes two key steps. First, the original data is isolated by a Quadtree Isolation to remove noise photons. Second, the ground photons are extracted from the signal by Cloth Simulation, followed by the retrieval of the ground elevation via interpolation. The results show that the algorithm framework can effectively extract signal photons and obtain high-precision ground elevation curves under different land cover and terrain conditions. Specifically, the noise removal algorithm not only reduces the negative impact of land cover and slope but can also adapt to changes in the data acquisition environment. The mean error and root mean square error of the retrieved ground elevation were -0.62 to -1.38 m and 1.74 to 2.74 m, respectively. This study provides an effective solution for estimating the ground elevation by using photon-counting LiDAR data.

articleTitle: Multi-feature gait pattern recognition system on account of genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: Gait recognition technology belongs to a new recognition technology applied in the biological category. This technology collects people's walking, so as to carry out data analysis and realize the functions of identity recognition, physiology, pathology and psychology. This technology has many advantages, such as remote video images, and recognition in the case of poor line of sight. In recent years, stations, banks, airports and other public locations have realized multi-angle customer service network systems, so experts in the field must improve the intelligence of remote scenes. A significant feature of gait recognition is that it can intercept the biometric features of human body or object from a long distance. So gait recognition technology in multiple scenarios, multiple applications is a very popular and practical technology. The test shows that the multi-feature gait pattern recognition system based on genetic algorithm has high performance in multi-feature gait pattern recognition.

articleTitle: Cyber-physical systems of smart agriculture driven by data and knowledge
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: In the field of smart agriculture research, common key technologies driven by data and knowledge play a vital role, which have attracted attention of a number of researchers. Firstly, current works on common key technologies of smart agriculture were surveyed. According to technology framework, the works can be divided as information perception, data transmission, data analysis, intelligent decision-making, intelligent agricultural machinery, and management software, etc. Secondly, the comprehensive application of common key technologies in smart agriculture were discussed further. Finally, directions for future development were prospected.

articleTitle: Non-performing asset pricing evaluation system based on BP neural network algorithm
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: Whether it is a bank or an enterprise, a large number of non-performing assets will affect its economic stability and weaken its competitiveness in the same industry. The non-performing asset pricing assessment conclusion is a reference for how to dispose of non-performing assets, while the non-performing asset pricing assessment methods and specifications are the key technologies that assessors need to keep in mind. The non-performing asset pricing evaluation system designed in this paper can help appraisers to realize asset pricing. The system includes a variety of pricing methods, and appropriate evaluation methods will be selected for different types of non-performing assets. In the functional test experiment of the system, it was found that the test values of each performance exceeded its theoretical setting value, so the performance reached the standard and met the design requirements. In the analysis system, the hypothesis clearing method, transaction case comparison method and BP neural network were used. In the case of three pricing models of pricing method, the pricing model based on BP neural network algorithm is beneficial to enhance the accuracy of system evaluation and reduce the evaluation error.

articleTitle: Research on numerical simulation of temperature field in directional solidification process controlled by finite element method
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: As an emerging metal heat treatment process, directional solidification technology has excellent properties exhibited by non-destructive materials at room temperature. It has become one of the current research hotspots and frontier topics in the field of engineering at home and abroad. In the industrial field, when the metal to be welded is welded, its own structural characteristics need to bear a large thermal load. In order to ensure the normal operation of the welding process and obtain good benefits, a finite element model must be established to simulate the temperature field changes in the process and corresponding compensation measures. Firstly, this paper analyzes the finite element discretization and numerical calculation method of the radiative heat transfer boundary, and establishes a directional solidification simulation model by using the finite element method, and then it establishes a directional solidification simulation model according to the mathematical change process of the temperature field; Secondly, this paper simulates the key technology of the temperature field in the directional solidification process with finite element method. Finally, the finite element method is used to analyze the mathematical model of the temperature field in the directional solidification process, and the calculation results are compared with the actual situation. It can be seen from the conclusion that the system simulation and theoretical prediction method established in this paper is correct, reasonable and accurate.

articleTitle: Application research on information entropy and K-Means algorithm
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: This paper selects Company X as the research data source, information entropy and K-Means algorithm are applied to these data to analyze the company's finance risk. It shows that this method is faster to carve out financial risk comparing with traditional method of power coefficient. First of all, we normalize the annual report data of Company X from 2016 to 2020 as four dimensions named profitability, operational ability, solvency and development and growth ability, calculates the entropy weights based on information entropy. The second step we screen the data in combination with correlation analysis, and determines the financial risk assessment index system of Company X. The third step is to evaluate the financial risk of Company X according to the industry efficacy coefficient method, and the fourth step is to use the K-Means algorithm to evaluate the financial risk of Company X, that is, to select the first echelon company in the express industry as the reference company, calculate the cluster centroid value of each indicator, use the cluster centroid value as a reference standard, weight the financial indicators of Company X. Finally, this paper compares the results of the efficacy coefficient method and the K-Means method to assess financial risks, and K-Means can find the financial risks of enterprises faster and it has certain advantages.

articleTitle: Dora algorithm in the calculation of shallow water wave equation
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: With the development of global water conservancy facilities, flood prevention, water environment, shipping and other large-scale engineering technologies, the shallow water problem has become a serious problem in various countries. One-dimensional shallow water wave model and two-dimensional shallow water wave model can only be applied to solve large engineering problems, due to the limitations of computer technology and data technology. Dora algorithm is a relatively new algorithm, mainly to solve the dynamic equations, which is relatively more physical significance, because it is less limited and more stable. Compared with traditional algorithms, Dora's algorithm is that it can solve the problem of initial water depth is zero. In the numerical simulation of dam rupture, Dora algorithm does not have numerical shocks in intermittent waves, which is enough to show that the algorithm can effectively simulate the movement of dam break waves. Dora's algorithm is absolutely stable. The Dora algorithm uses either the block-wise operator method or the step-wise method. The Dora algorithm solves the problem of water depth being zero when solving the St. Vennan equation. No special treatment is required to simulate flood movements in the mainstream, such as dam breaks. The paper mainly focuses on the Dora algorithm and the advantage comparison of the algorithm and the traditional algorithm. The final results show that the algorithm can satisfy the one-dimensional shallow water wave equation and solve the situation without water depth. Whether it is one-dimensional or two-dimensional shallow water wave models, they are able to well simulate the long straight open channel constant flow for the curve constant flow. For the water level, the simulation results of the one-dimensional shallow water wave equation are not accurate, and the two-dimensional shallow water wave model can be closer to the experimental value of the dam break.

articleTitle: Research on British and American literature resources system based on cloud storage
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: The rapid growth of data in the information age limits traditional storage technologies and the ability to manage data, and cloud storage systems emerge as the times require. Cloud storage is a new business application model that integrates a large number of resources in a distributed form and provides integrated services to users. Cloud computing, which relies on thousands of cheap computers, has dramatically reduced server costs. Cloud storage technology can effectively solve the problems of high storage cost, low sharing rate and irregular management of educational resources. In order to meet the needs of English education in the information age, this paper studies the English and American literature resource system based on cloud storage, and completes the system architecture design, data structure design and upload module design, which is convenient for software developers to build the system.

articleTitle: Application of QPSO algorithm in layout optimization of construction platform of prefabricated buildings
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: With the development of the times, the construction industry has become one of the important pillars of the national economy, but the architectural style under the traditional model is no longer suitable for my country's increasing demand for high-quality construction products. my country's construction industry has now entered a high-quality In the stage of development, prefabricated buildings have entered the era of rise. Prefabricated buildings generally adopt standardized design and standardized construction methods. The buildings have the characteristics of green, environmental protection and high efficiency. With the development of prefabricated buildings, the integration of QPSO algorithm and prefabricated technology has become a hot spot in current architectural design. This paper adopts The QPSO algorithm is applied to the layout optimization of the construction platform of the prefabricated building group, and the corresponding construction platform layout optimization scheme is proposed. In view of the weakness of the QPSO algorithm in the single particle search energy in the complex environment, the pheromone mechanism in the ACO algorithm is introduced to obtain The improved quantum particle swarm optimization algorithm, this paper mainly studies the layout optimization scheme of the construction platform of the prefabricated building group, verifies the feasibility of the entire optimization and simulation process, and forms a systematic, scientific and operable platform management process, from theory to practice. Prefabricated assembly Research on platform layout optimization and simulation of modern buildings. The final results of the research show that when the construction cost of the frame component is 50 yuan, the number of iterations of the QPSO algorithm is 196, the number of iterations of the PSO algorithm is 168, and the number of iterations of the GA algorithm is 156, and the number of iterations of the QPSO algorithm is greater than the other two algorithms.

articleTitle: 3D Immersive experience of calligraphy art based on digital technology
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: With the help of digital technology, Chinese calligraphy art can enhance people's immersive experience of culture, thereby deepening the understanding of traditional culture. This article attempts to focus on three aspects, playing the role of synesthesia, enhancing the visual and cultural implications of calligraphy in digital products, and the immersive experience enhances the perception of the artistic charm and artistic conception of calligraphy, of the application process of digital technology, to explore how the immersive experience applied in calligraphy art, how to gradually shift from the audio-visual experience to the perception of calligraphy space, charm and even artistic conception. How to improve the application path so that writers can feel and understand traditional culture more deeply.

articleTitle: Video editing technology based on image special effect filter algorithm
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: With the improvement of living standards and the popularity of computer, web and camera applications, people can easily capture many image and video footage and applications. However, how to effectively use image special effects filters for image or video editing and design and create new digital content that meets specific requirements has become an urgent problem to be solved. The purpose of this paper is to research video editing technology based on image special effect filter algorithm. This paper proposes a variety of filter and stylization implementation methods including multiple types of filters, image abstraction stylization, and image style transfer. Ideal algorithm result. Experiments show that compared with the experimental results of compressed images, the method in this paper achieves the lowest Pe in most training-test pairs, and the lowest value is even close to 1.

articleTitle: Operation monitoring and management system of experimental equipment based on Internet of Things (IOT) technology
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: With the country's emphasis on scientific experiments and practical education, laboratory-related construction is also deepening, and investment in construction is also increasing. However, with the emphasis on experimental construction, the demand for laboratories and their equipment continues to expand, but Equipment prices are not low. Therefore, maintaining equipment is also a very important task. For sustainable development, the monitoring and management system of the laboratory also needs to be constantly standardized and improved. The main purpose of this paper is to design and improve the monitoring and management system for the operation of the laboratory and its equipment by using the related technologies of the IOF. Experiments show that the A/D conversion method is more flexible. After replacing the device, the current threshold can be reset. Therefore, the system adopts A/D method to collect current data.

articleTitle: Application research on ecological environment prevention and monitoring based on Beidou navigation Intelligent System (IS)
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: As China's Beidou satellite navigation system has fully covered the Asia Pacific region and the commercialization of BDS navigation industry has taken the lead in pilot promotion in the field of transportation, satellite navigation based IS has become a hot spot in the research of ecological environment prevention and monitoring. This paper discusses the index system and principle of Beidou navigation ground measurement and control system and Beidou IS ecological environment monitoring. By taking the temperature, humidity, wind speed and historical visibility values of the predicted day as sample data, the application of ecological environment prevention and monitoring of Beidou navigation IS is detected; The results showed that the range of temperature change in one week was 23.1 ∼ 24.3°C, and the difference was 0.1°C; The highest humidity is 84.9%, and the lowest humidity is 58.9%; When the maximum visibility is 15.1m in a week, the wind force is 4.9m/s; When the minimum visibility is 3.3m, the wind force is 1.8m/s. There is no significant relationship between daily temperature, humidity, wind speed and historical visibility value in a week. Therefore, the application of Beidou navigation intelligent monitoring system and ecological environment prevention and control monitoring can timely and accurately monitor and analyze the environmental conditions.

articleTitle: Application analysis of computer technology in image recognition
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: In recent years, people have begun to apply computer technology to various fields, which has led to the rapid development of computer image analysis. Computer image analysis can fully reflect the structural characteristics of the surface of an object, and can perform objective judgments and recognition, which is a relatively ideal detection method. It is very important to analyze and study the commonalities and characteristics of objects reasonably and accurately, and extract effective indicators to improve the ability of discrimination. The purpose of this article is to study the application of computer technology in image recognition. This paper proposes a detection method based on gray scale transformation and supplemented by frequency domain transformation. Comprehensive use of image segmentation, edge extraction, and image restoration technology. This paper analyzes and compares the surface morphology of cashmere and wool fibers, and finds indicators that can effectively distinguish the two, such as fiber diameter, diameter-to-height ratio, visible height of scales, etc., and compares the obtained fiber images under the scanning electron microscope. Carry out a series of processing in order to obtain the above-mentioned characteristic parameters, so as to carry out analysis and research, establish a characteristic database, use the statistical model of BP neural network, carry out sample training, achieve the purpose of effective identification, and finally establish a set of automatic wool and cashmere fibers. The analysis and recognition system provides a strong theoretical basis. Experimental research shows that this paper can calculate from the measurement data that the average diameters of cashmere fiber and wool fiber are 14.5ìm and 18.46ìm, respectively, and the average scale heights are 16.27ìm and 11.52ìm, which can prove that the measured data are within tolerance. Therefore, it can be explained that the index extraction method used in this article is effective.

articleTitle: Clustering method and data transmission algorithm of LEACH protocol optimized for energy efficiency
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: With the rapid development of science and technology today, people's need to grasp information in real time has become more and more urgent. The purpose of this paper is to study the energy efficiency optimized LEACH protocol clustering method and data transmission algorithm. This paper introduces the background and significance of the research content of this paper from the perspectives of the unique advantages, development prospects, application requirements and energy issues of wireless sensor networks, briefly introduces the structure of wireless sensor networks and the working modules inside sensor nodes, and analyzes wireless transmission The characteristics and application scenarios of the sensor network, the second part sorts out two important routing protocols used in the wireless sensor network, and uses the cuckoo search algorithm to select the optimal dynamic route to the sink node for each cluster head in each “round”. The system gradually completes the deployment of all marine environment monitoring stations in the North Sea area by adopting the energy-efficiency-optimized LEACH protocol clustering method. Compared with the LEACH protocol and the LEACH-M algorithm, the algorithm proposed in this paper has the best network performance, and the time for the 100th node to die is about 800 rounds.

articleTitle: Investigation and research on the construction of library VR intelligent system
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: Virtual technology is more and more widely used in all walks of life. VR technology which can present simulated virtual reality scenes is an important technical means for smart libraries to implement human-computer interaction, realize immersive reading and complete virtual experience in the future. Starting from the literature and questionnaire survey, this paper puts forward some suggestions on the construction of VR intelligent system in the library of higher vocational colleges, in order to help teachers and students in higher vocational colleges get a better and efficient sense of experience.

articleTitle: A novel association rules data mining method of incremental and time series based Hadoop
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: Time series data association rule mining needs to go through time series preprocessing, time series compression and other steps. The effectiveness of mining methods mainly depends on the reliability of mining association rules. The advantage of incremental association rules lies in the mining of dynamic data. The CAN-tree can be constructed by scanning the transaction set only once, which improves the mining efficiency of incremental association rules. This paper studies how to mine valuable rules from massive data through association rules on cloud computing Hadoop platform. This paper proposes a new association rules data mining method of time series and incremental based on Hadoop platform.

articleTitle: DBSCAN algorithm application based on 5G+ interactive physical education system
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: With the rapid development of computer technology and network communication technology, digital signal communication, video and audio processing and other new applications are becoming more and more popular. As a new intelligent teaching mode, physical education teaching system will greatly improve students' learning efficiency. This paper takes 5G+ interactive teaching system as the main research object. Firstly, this paper studies the role and characteristics of 5G+ interactive sports teaching system, and then studies the basic principle and related application of DBSCAN algorithm. Based on the algorithm's help to 5G+ interactive sports teaching system, the performance of the algorithm in the system is tested. The final test shows that the technology has high precision, stability and scalability. In addition, it can also achieve friendly user interface friendly user interface friendly operating environment good experience and other advantages.

articleTitle: Construction and analysis of computer science data model based on fuzzy neural network
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: In the modern era of rapid scientific research, researchers pay more and more attention to scientific data. With the rapid development of scientific research, people pay more attention to practice while pursuing innovative scientific research. Judging from the basic data published by scientific research, scientific data has grown exponentially, highlighting uneven distribution and heterogeneity. This paper aims to study the construction and analysis of computer science data model based on fuzzy neural network. On the basis of sorting out the research results of computer science data and fuzzy neural network at home and abroad, analyzing the problems of computer science data and the technical advantages of fuzzy neural network, this paper clarifies the process of building a computer science data model, and constructs a computer based on an associated fuzzy neural network. Scientific data models and propose conditions for model implementation. Experiments show that the data induction speed of the computer science data model constructed in this paper is about 8 times that of the traditional algorithm. Extracting scientific data is also more accurate.

articleTitle: Adaptive japanese learning system based on computer network
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: With the rapid development of the application of digital information technology in China in recent years, and the gradual popularization and application of mobile communication technology, the emergence of digital language online learning application system becomes a natural course. The digital language learning system is very closely related to the theory of modern education in China. It will create and develop a new form of digital education technology facilities by establishing such a new concept of digital language laboratory and using the latest advanced network technology. The formal emergence of digital language online learning and training system will undoubtedly have a huge impact on the fundamental change in the development mode of primary and secondary education in China, and will strongly promote the modernization of language teaching in China. With the emergence of more and more online learning systems, users can learn online anytime and anywhere in the learning system environment.

articleTitle: Air quality monitoring data calibration model by Spss Software and by programming of Matlab
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: CO, O3, NO2, SO2, PM10, PM2.5 of air are pollutants that contaminate the ecological environment and the air quality endangering human health. Contaminants of air quality (CO, O3, NO2, SO2, PM10, PM2.5) are monitored by using miniature detectors. The analysis of exploration is conducted about the data from national controlling points and self-building points by Spss Software. The reasons for the difference are analyzed about the data between the national controlling points and the self-building points by Spss Software and by programming of Matlab. The self-building point data are corrected by programming of Matlab

articleTitle: Intelligent database of face recognition on account of Lingo3G clustering algorithm
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: With the continuous progress of mobile network and the acceleration of mobile education, the popularity of smart devices is accelerating, and the utilization rate is increasing day by day. More and more people develop application software to assist learning. In the context of the rapid development of the Internet, students can use more and more information learning resources, using these Internet resources can improve their studies more efficiently, but the Internet is two-sided, the Internet will destroy good academic learning habits and life style in the bad aspect. The development of a face recognition system for the university in particular to identify students using the Internet is good and bad to identify, distinguish, for improving students' studies has a significant effect. This paper studies the construction of intelligent database of face recognition based on Lingo3G clustering algorithm, mainly introduces the function and construction of intelligent database of face recognition and other related content. The test shows that the intelligent database construction of face recognition based on Lingo3G clustering algorithm greatly improves the accuracy of the database in face recognition.

articleTitle: Spatial planning multi-scale processing of geographic spatiotemporal big data based on image recognition technology
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: With the rapid development of computing, the era of big data has followed. Apps for mobile smartphones and many IoT projects create vast amounts of field data. Among them, geospatial data processing is an important part of these applications. How to locate and analyze such a large amount of field data quickly and efficiently has become a major challenge. The main purpose of this paper is to conduct multi-scale processing research on spatial planning of geographic spatiotemporal big data based on image recognition technology. In this paper, the indexing technology of spatial data is presented, the feasibility is determined by image features, and the calculation is performed by spatial proximity query and partial differential of kernel function in scale space. Experiments show that when the nearest neighbor query k = 100, 1000 and 10000, the query time consumed by both algorithms keeps increasing.

articleTitle: Simulated topographic ventilation model based on phoenics analysis in CFD
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: As an effective process of passive energy saving, natural ventilation can not only use renewable energy to reduce non-renewable energy, but also improve indoor air quality, providing people with a healthier and more comfortable environment. With the gradual creation of sustainable development space, people pay more and more attention to energy saving, and natural ventilation is also regarded as a system and environmentally friendly ventilation technology. Natural ventilation is an important technical dimension in the construction of greenhouse today. The dual driving force of air pressure and thermal pressure can promote the generation of natural air, thus achieving global cooling, improve thermal comfort, and improve indoor air quality by blowing fresh air. The air pressure and the hot air pressure are always constant and unbalanced. Based on the scientific basis of near air pressure, the effect of the simulated ventilation model is analyzed using CFD phoenics software. Based on CFD numerical simulation technology, the typical structure is simulated on phoenics software platform, and some rules are obtained through analysis. The numerical model uses k-turbulence model, adopts the finite volume method for discrete, second order windward dispersion format, and the algorithm adopts SIMPLE algorithm coupled with speed and pressure. Finally, the outdoor building layout and the exterior window parameters of the typical rooms are obtained, so that the community building can meet the requirements of green ventilation. The experiment has proved that under the simulated terrain of this paper, the average number of indoor air ventilation can reach about 5 times, the air air age is small, and the air quality is improved.

articleTitle: Indoor gymnasium virtual system using data mining algorithm
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: With the call for national health and people's attention to sports events, more and more people are participating in sports. However, the increasing user demand and problems such as insufficient venues and insufficient funds have reduced the chances of people entering the gymnasium. In order to enable more people to understand the layout of the gymnasium and participate in sports activities at home, this paper uses virtual reality technology to develop an indoor sports virtual system, which not only allows people to roam in the gymnasium without leaving their homes, but also optimizes the allocation of venue resources. The system uses the free and open source Away3D engine as the development platform, uses 3DSMAX software to model, and processes gym pictures or videos through Photoshop software to restore the real gym scene. In order to verify the cross-platform and efficient rendering of the system, this paper tests the scene rendering frame rate of the system running on different terminals. The experimental results show that the system has the highest rendering frame rate on the computer terminal whether it is a single-person roaming process or a multi-person roaming process. And the survey experiment using data mining technology to analyze user satisfaction also proves that the system meets the design requirements and reaches the user's use standard.

articleTitle: Research on five axis machining method and manufacturing technology of impeller
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: The aviation industry is a symbol of a country's comprehensive strength. Among the aviation parts, the impeller and blade are the core components of the engine. They are widely used in aerospace, ship navigation, mineral machinery, national defense and military industry. Their material is hard, the profile is complex and distorted, the blade is thin, the spacing is small, and the surface accuracy is streamlined [1], Aeroengine manufacturing technology has become the standard of a country's scientific and technological strength. Therefore, the research on the manufacturing and processing technology of impellers and blades has important research value for all types of aircraft, military equipment, automobiles, ships and civil equipment, and has important strategic significance for economy and national defense. Based on the analysis of the functions and characteristics of five axis machining and the application of the operating principle and structural characteristics of jet engine impeller, the machining process and program of five axis machining of impeller are compiled in this paper.

articleTitle: An improved scheme of practical Byzantine fault tolerant algorithm
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: Blockchain technology has become the hottest technology in the market because of its characteristics such as decentralization and data tamper resistance. With the development of blockchain, it is widely used in many fields. There are many types of blockchain, such as alliance chain, private chain and public chain. At present, the alliance chain has attracted extensive attention, but the commonly used PBFT algorithm still has many problems. In order to solve the high communication overhead and low efciency of PBFT consensus echanism, an improved PBFT consensus algorithm with a reputation mechanism are proposed in this paper. Diff erent permissions of nodes are made according to their diff erent reputation levels. Only the nodes with high reputation are qualifed to act as master nodes. Nodes with low reputation will be prohibited from participating in the consistency protocol and reduce the probability of becoming master nodes. In our scheme, the security, efciency and throughput of the consensus algorithm are improved, and the communication cost is reduced.

articleTitle: Multi-rotor UAV reinforcement learning control modeling and algorithm design
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: UAV does not need to be operated by a pilot. It mainly uses radio communication to receive flight instruction information from the ground station to complete various flight tasks. But the design of the UAV needs to keep the flight position and state stable according to the dynamics and control theory. This paper takes the quadrotor UAV as an example, introduces a variety of UAV control technologies, and then uses reinforcement learning and Newton-Euler method to establish a dynamic model according to its flight principle, and designs a position and attitude controller based on sliding mode control theory, the robust response value of the controller is tested to prove the strong anti-interference performance of the sliding mode controller.

articleTitle: Smart e-Health apps: an overview
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: Smart healthcare is a relatively new context-aware healthcare paradigm influenced by multiple knowledge disciplines, including medical informatics, communications and electronics, biotechnology, and ethics. Therefore, there are many difficult problems in smart healthcare, but they are often considered separately for each field, leading to more concrete smart healthcare activities. Not necessarily well known to the research community.The purpose of this article is to identify the most relevant trends and research directions that will impact the smart healthcare sector in the coming years. flat). Identifying and categorizing these research trends and challenges will help address the issues facing the smart healthcare community. This provides a common basis for research on key issues in this field that will have a major impact in the years to come.

articleTitle: Early warning algorithm of financial crisis based on random forest
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: The in-depth development of my country's market economy has brought more growth opportunities for Chinese enterprises, making them grow faster. But at the same time, it also makes the Chinese market more complex, changeable and riskier, and Chinese enterprises are faced with increasingly complex and difficult challenges in the fiercely competitive environment. Economic crises for businesses can have devastating consequences such as investment losses, worker unemployment, and irreversible credit, which in turn affects a country's economic growth, financial stability, and social stability. It is therefore very necessary and urgent to update the model of the pre-existing financial crisis and identify emerging companies. This pap er is intended to investigate an economically stimulating algorithm based on random forests. On the basis of analyzing the causes of financial crisis and random forest algorithm, 196 listed companies with A shares in our country's Shenzhen and Shanghai stock markets from 2019 to 2020 are selected as research samples to construct A financial crisis early warning model based on random forest is presented. In order to evaluate the predictive ability of the model, this paper establishes three models of RF, CART and SVM for comparative analysis. The results show that the total accuracy of the random forest algorithm, the prediction accuracy of risk companies, and the prediction accuracy of healthy companies have reached a relatively balanced level, and the prediction accuracy is above 83%.

articleTitle: Application of computer virtual reality technology in the design of indoor space under the background of data
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: With the growth of economy, virtual reality (VR) technology has received lots attention and has been applied to all walks of life. Due to the interactive, immersive and VR nature of the false report reality technology, its application in the field of architecture has a wide range of prospects. The advantages of this technology are unmatched by other technologies. The interior space design using VR allows designers and users to experience what you see is what you get. At the same time, it also allows users to put the Buddha in the virtual scene of this design and feel the immersive mood. This article aims to study the application of computer VR technology in the design of indoor space under the background of data. On the basis of analyzing the characteristics of VR technology, the application field and the necessity of applying it to indoor space design, the questionnaire method is used to investigate the indoor space. Designers and the public conduct surveys to understand their evaluation of interior space design and process. The survey results show that the effect of VR technology in interior space design is good, the production difficulty is moderate, and the production process is easy to modify. Therefore, VR technology helps designers to design and produce interior spaces.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of streaming media player for monitoring system based on computer information technology
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: In recent years, information streaming media has developed very rapidly. With the rapid popularization of computer technology and network information technology. We can find that the number of Internet platform users is increasing. In order to normalize people's lives, they need to be monitored. Therefore, in order to obtain a smooth and clear monitoring picture, the player needs to be designed. This paper mainly uses the experimental method and the comparative method to test the performance of the player of the monitoring system in different environments. The experimental data shows that the stability and robustness of the player can reach more than 85%, which is enough to meet the basic needs.

articleTitle: Blockchain-based power material supply chain data storage system
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: In view of the current entire business cycle management of the power material supply chain, the difficulty in information sharing are common in business links such as power contract signing, production scheduling, logistics and distribution. This paper designs a blockchain-based data storage system for the power material supply chain. Through the integration of a centralized identity module, a data credible storage module and a smart contract management module, it provides data for the entire business cycle of the power materials supply chain with transparent, true and credible features.

articleTitle: A survey of specific emitter identification
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: Radio frequency fingerprinting (RFF) refers to the technology of Specific Emitter Identification(SEI) by extracting device signals at the physical layer. By extracting the unique RFF of wireless devices at the physical layer, it is used to identify specific individuals and prevent malicious attacks, and ultimately improve network security. This paper first introduces the principle of RF fingerprint generation, and analyzes the related research from two aspects of transient extraction and steady state extraction by analyzing the process of RFF feature extraction and recognition. Then, by sorting out the latest papers on RF fingerprint recognition in the past three years, the extraction methods are classified and theoretically analyzed. In the RFF identification stage, we analyzed several commonly used classification methods, and summarized the advantages and disadvantages of several commonly used methods. Finally, an outlook is made on the future development prospects of RFF, and the views on issues related to the future development of RFF are put forward.

articleTitle: English intelligent translation pattern recognition system on account of improved GLR algorithm
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: The existing traditional algorithms often have problems of inaccurate results and incorrect data processing. Now it is proposed to adopt the improved GLR algorithm to construct the intelligent recognition mode of English translation, so as to improve the accuracy of the intelligent translation mode. This algorithm facilitates the formation of a corpus of tens of thousands of English words that can be searched by themselves. This model consists of data collection, data processing and data output. Through the strict logic to collect the English signal, and extract the feature vector, finally achieve the purpose of automatic recognition of English words. In the whole process, the algorithm will record the data intelligently and process the recorded data. At the same time, it will record the accuracy of the previous English translation and conduct intelligent learning to gradually improve the accuracy of English translation. This paper studies the improved GLR algorithm, proposes the pattern recognition suitable for English intelligent translation, and analyzes the internal working principle. Data show that GLR algorithm can greatly improve the performance of pattern recognition in intelligent English translation.

articleTitle: A survey of radio frequency fingerprint feature extraction and recognition based on deep learning
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: Unique structures in the electromagnetic waves emitted by the transmitter are called Radio Frequency Fingerprinting (RFF). By extracting the unique radio frequency fingerprints of wireless devices at the physical layer, it can be used to identify specific individuals and prevent malicious attacks, ultimately improving network security. The method of identifying transmitters through unique machine fingerprints is called specific emitter identification. At present, RFF is mainly used in two parts, military and civilian. The military field uses RFF to identify strategic equipment such as radar, and the civilian field uses RFF to improve network security. First, the collected signals are extracted with features, and then the extracted features are classified and identified, so as to match specific emitters. This paper first starts from the generation of RFF, introduces the traditional extraction and identification methods, and then combines the current development of deep learning, summarizes the RFF extraction and identification based on deep learning, analyzes the advantages of deep learning methods compared with traditional methods.Finally, an outlook is made on the future development prospects of RF fingerprints, and opinions on the future development of RF fingerprints are put forward.

articleTitle: Emerging AI and cloud computing paradigms applied to healthcare
publicationTitle: The International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability (FoNeS 2022)
abstract: Artificial intelligence is concerned with mimicking the human mind by leveraging computers and machines to solve real-life problems and ease decision-making processes. At the same time, Cloud Computing is involved with storing and transforming data into usable services. Cloud computing and Artificial intelligence aim to solve real -life problems and make work/decision-making processes easier and more reliable. This study summarizes the architecture, prominent roles, and new trends of Artificial Intelligence and cloud computing by comprehensively providing an overview of Artificial Intelligence and cloud computing paradigms. This study also highlights the current medical applications of Artificial Intelligence and cloud computing concepts. It discusses some challenges that impede th e overall performance of this technology and the promising opportunities.
